items.title: Impact of Adding Fatigue-Focused Cognitive Behavior Therapy to Supervised Pilates-Based Core Stability Training on Balance and Walking in Patients with Multiple Sclerosis: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A double-blind RCT found adding cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) to supervised Pilates-based core stability training significantly improved balance and gait more than Pilates alone. After 8 weeks, the study group showed greater reduction in overall stability index (mean difference -0.59, 95% CI: -0.70 to -0.48; p < .001) and increase in cadence (mean difference 8.22 steps/min, 95% CI: 4.40 to 12.04; p < .001) compared to the control group.
items.curatedReason: 本项RCT有力证明了在多发性硬化症（MS）患者的普拉提核心稳定性训练中加入以疲劳为重点的认知行为疗法（CBT），能显著优于单独普拉提训练，在平衡和步态参数上带来更大的改善。整体稳定性指数和步频的显著提升，为MS患者的康复提供了更有效的干预策略。考虑在临床中为MS患者提供普拉提时，引入CBT以提升平衡和步态功能。
items.titleZh: 疲劳为重点的认知行为疗法联合普拉提核心稳定性训练对多发性硬化症患者平衡和步态的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项双盲随机对照试验发现，在普拉提核心稳定性训练中加入认知行为疗法（CBT）比单独普拉提训练能更显著地改善平衡和步态。8周后，研究组的整体稳定性指数下降更多（平均差 -0.59, 95% CI: -0.70 to -0.48; p < .001），步频增加更多（平均差 8.22 步/分钟, 95% CI: 4.40 to 12.04; p < .001），相较于对照组。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT strongly demonstrates that adding fatigue-focused cognitive behavior therapy (CBT) to supervised Pilates-based core stability training in multiple sclerosis (MS) patients significantly outperforms Pilates alone, leading to greater improvements in balance and walking parameters. The notable enhancements in overall stability index and cadence offer a more effective intervention strategy for MS rehabilitation. Consider incorporating CBT with Pilates for MS patients in clinical practice to enhance balance and gait function.
items.limitation: 本研究的长期随访结果未知，且是在单一中心进行，可能限制了结果的外推性。
items.limitationEn: Long-term follow-up results are unknown, and the study was conducted at a single center, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Improvement in functional movement, landing mechanics, and dynamic balance following TRX training in physically active athletes after ACL reconstruction: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found a 6-week TRX suspension training program significantly improved dynamic balance (e.g., anterior reach: F=33.527, p<0.001), movement quality (FMS scores: F=251.994, p<0.001), and landing mechanics (LESS scores: F=75.385, p<0.001) more than traditional rehabilitation in male athletes after ACL reconstruction.
items.curatedReason: 本项随机对照试验明确指出，在ACL重建术后的康复中，TRX悬吊训练比传统康复更能显著改善运动员的功能性动作、着陆力学和动态平衡。这些结果提示TRX训练作为高级康复阶段的干预手段，应被考虑纳入重返运动前的康复方案，以提升患者的运动表现和安全性。
items.titleZh: ACL重建术后体能活跃运动员TRX训练对功能性动作、着陆力学和动态平衡的改善：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，为期六周的TRX悬吊训练方案在ACL重建术后的男性运动员中，相比传统康复，显著改善了动态平衡（如前向伸展：F=33.527, p<0.001）、动作质量（FMS评分：F=251.994, p<0.001）和着陆力学（LESS评分：F=75.385, p<0.001）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled trial clearly indicates that TRX suspension training significantly improves functional movement, landing mechanics, and dynamic balance in athletes after ACL reconstruction, outperforming traditional rehabilitation. These results suggest TRX training should be considered for advanced rehabilitation phases before return to sport to enhance patient performance and safety.
items.limitation: 本研究随访时间较短，长期效果和重返运动后再次损伤率未知，且研究对象仅限男性运动员。
items.limitationEn: The study has a short follow-up period, with unknown long-term effects and re-injury rates after return to sport, and participants were exclusively male athletes.

items.title: Patients treated with rehabilitation alone after anterior cruciate ligament injury display greater muscle strength symmetry, yet lower absolute muscle strength normalized to bodyweight compared to reconstruction: A Cross-sectional study of 3,093 patients.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 3,093 ACL patients (2707 ACLR; 386 rehabilitation) found that those treated with rehabilitation alone had greater muscle strength symmetry at all follow-ups but lower absolute strength normalized to bodyweight in the uninjured limb. They also reported higher KOOS symptoms but inferior knee self-efficacy compared to ACLR patients.
items.curatedReason: 本项基于大型注册数据的研究发现，仅接受康复治疗的ACL损伤患者比接受ACL重建的患者表现出更好的肌肉力量对称性，但在未受伤肢体的绝对肌力（标准化到体重）上较低。这提示我们在选择治疗方案时，除了患者年龄和活动水平，还需综合考虑患者的肌力特征和自我效能预期，并针对性地进行康复干预。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带损伤后仅接受康复治疗的患者与重建手术患者相比，肌肉力量对称性更高，但绝对肌力（标准化到体重）较低：一项对3,093名患者的横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对3,093例前交叉韧带（ACL）损伤患者（2707例重建术后；386例仅康复）的横断面研究发现，仅接受康复治疗的患者在所有随访中均表现出更好的肌肉力量对称性，但在未受伤肢体的绝对肌力（标准化到体重）上较低。与ACL重建患者相比，他们还报告了更高的KOOS症状评分，但膝关节自我效能感较差。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large registry-based study found that ACL injury patients treated with rehabilitation alone exhibited greater muscle strength symmetry but lower absolute strength (normalized to bodyweight) in the uninjured limb compared to those undergoing ACL reconstruction. This suggests that when selecting treatment, beyond age and activity level, clinicians should consider muscle strength characteristics and self-efficacy expectations, and tailor rehabilitation interventions accordingly.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，虽然样本量大，但存在选择偏倚，可能无法完全控制患者在治疗选择上的初始差异。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cohort study, and despite a large sample size, it may be subject to selection bias, potentially not fully controlling for initial differences in treatment choices among patients.

items.title: Comparative diagnostic utility of SPECT-CT versus MRI and CT in chronic low back pain.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (n=122 patients, 610 levels) found SPECT-CT positivity was moderately and independently associated with Modic changes (OR 6.40, 95% CI 3.09-13.27), Pfirrmann 4-5 (OR 17.27, 95% CI 3.80-78.46), and vacuum disc (OR 2.69, 95% CI 1.30-5.58) in chronic low back pain. However, findings were frequently discordant, with 60.7% of Pfirrmann 4-5 levels being SPECT-EP-negative.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，SPECT-CT在慢性腰痛诊断中可能补充MRI和CT的结构性发现。虽然SPECT-CT阳性与Modic改变、Pfirrmann分级和真空盘/关节现象中度相关，但三种影像学结果存在明显不一致，这提醒我们不能将代谢和结构发现互换。未来需基于结局的验证才能明确SPECT-CT在识别有症状节段中的作用。
items.titleZh: SPECT-CT与MRI和CT在慢性腰痛诊断中的比较诊断效用
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（122名患者，610个节段）发现，在慢性腰痛中，SPECT-CT阳性与Modic改变（OR 6.40, 95% CI 3.09-13.27）、Pfirrmann 4-5级（OR 17.27, 95% CI 3.80-78.46）和真空盘现象（OR 2.69, 95% CI 1.30-5.58）中度且独立相关。然而，影像学结果经常不一致，60.7%的Pfirrmann 4-5级节段SPECT-EP阴性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests SPECT-CT may complement MRI and CT structural findings in chronic low back pain diagnosis. While SPECT-CT positivity is moderately associated with Modic changes, Pfirrmann grade, and vacuum disc/facet phenomena, significant discordance exists among the three imaging modalities, indicating that metabolic and structural findings are not interchangeable. Future outcome-based validation is needed to clarify SPECT-CT's role in identifying symptomatic levels.
items.limitation: 本研究是回顾性单机构队列研究，可能存在选择偏倚，且未能通过结局验证SPECT-CT阳性是否识别了有症状的椎体节段。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective single-institution cohort study, potentially subject to selection bias, and it did not validate whether SPECT-CT positivity identified symptomatic levels through outcome measures.

items.title: Injury risk and physical therapy utilization following knee surgery in U.S. Army soldiers: a comparison of military and non-military treatment facilities.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (n=4924 U.S. Army soldiers) found that 75% sustained a subsequent injury within 1-3 years of knee surgery. Soldiers treated at non-military treatment facilities (32%) had higher injury rates (79% vs. 73%) and longer physical therapy duration (8.3 vs. 7.1 weeks; p = 0.038) compared to those treated at military treatment facilities (MTFs), with adjusted odds of subsequent injury being 1.22 (95% CI [1.04-1.44]) higher at non-MTFs.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对美国陆军士兵的回顾性研究显示，在非军事医疗机构（非MTFs）接受膝关节手术的士兵，其后续受伤风险和物理治疗时长均高于在军事医疗机构（MTFs）接受治疗的士兵。这些发现提示治疗环境可能影响康复结局，对需要康复的现役军人，应考量医疗机构的选择。
items.titleZh: 美国陆军士兵膝关节手术后损伤风险和物理治疗利用情况：军事与非军事医疗机构的比较
items.summaryZh: 一项对4924名美国陆军士兵的回顾性队列研究发现，75%的士兵在膝关节手术后1-3年内发生后续损伤。在非军事医疗机构（32%）接受治疗的士兵，其损伤率（79% vs. 73%）和物理治疗时长（8.3 vs. 7.1周；p = 0.038）均高于在军事医疗机构接受治疗的士兵，调整后非军事医疗机构的后续损伤几率高出1.22倍（95% CI [1.04-1.44]）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study of U.S. Army soldiers shows that those undergoing knee surgery at non-military treatment facilities (non-MTFs) had higher subsequent injury rates and longer physical therapy durations than those treated at military treatment facilities (MTFs). These findings suggest that treatment settings may influence rehabilitation outcomes, and the choice of facility should be considered for active-duty servicemembers requiring rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，可能存在混杂因素，且未深入探讨导致MTF与非MTF之间差异的具体原因。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cohort study, potentially subject to confounding factors, and it did not delve into the specific reasons for the differences observed between MTFs and non-MTFs.

items.title: Should Nerve Transfer Surgery be the Standard of Care for Cervical Spinal Cord Injury?
items.summary: A critical analysis of the literature highlights nerve transfer surgery as a promising intervention for improving upper limb function following cervical spinal cord injury, with generally positive aggregate outcomes but variable individual responses. It also discusses peri-operative challenges, potential benefits of combining nerve and tendon transfer, and the impact on spasticity.
items.curatedReason: 本述评肯定了神经转移手术在改善脊髓颈段损伤患者上肢功能方面的潜力，但同时强调仍存在知识空白，尤其是在最佳手术时机、康复方案和结局变异性方面。临床实践中，应将神经转移手术视为一种有前景但仍需个体化考量的治疗选项，并在康复中注意结合腱转移和痉挛管理。
items.titleZh: 神经转移手术是否应成为颈脊髓损伤的标准治疗？
items.summaryZh: 一项对文献的批判性分析强调，神经转移手术是改善颈脊髓损伤后上肢功能的有前景的干预措施，总体结局积极但个体反应存在差异。该分析还讨论了围手术期挑战、联合神经和肌腱转移的潜在益处，以及其对痉挛的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary affirms the potential of nerve transfer surgery to improve upper limb function in cervical spinal cord injury patients but also highlights existing knowledge gaps, particularly regarding optimal surgical timing, rehabilitation protocols, and outcome variability. In clinical practice, nerve transfer surgery should be considered a promising but individualized treatment option, with attention to combining tendon transfer and spasticity management in rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为专家述评，基于现有文献进行分析，缺乏新的实证数据支持。
items.limitationEn: This is an expert commentary based on existing literature analysis, lacking new empirical data.

items.title: Aqua Steps: A Feasibility Study of a new Aquatic Exercise Therapy Intervention for Falls Prevention in Older Adults.
items.summary: A feasibility study (n=101 older adults at high falls risk) for the Aqua Steps aquatic exercise intervention showed high feasibility (88% retention, 90% adherence) and safety. After 16 weeks, falls, fallers, and frequent fallers were reduced by 38%, 36%, and 58% respectively, with significant improvements in functional (22%-70%) and strength (10%-80%) tests, falls efficacy (11%), and balance confidence (8%).
items.curatedReason: 本项可行性研究表明，Aqua Steps水上运动疗法在老年人防跌倒方面具有很高的可行性、可接受性和安全性，并初步显示出减少跌倒和改善功能、力量和平衡的潜力。这些积极发现支持开展更大规模的试验以确认其效果，对未来跌倒预防运动政策的制定有重要参考价值。
items.titleZh: Aqua Steps：一项针对老年人跌倒预防新型水上运动疗法干预的可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对101名高跌倒风险老年人的Aqua Steps水上运动干预可行性研究显示出高可行性（88%保留率，90%依从性）和安全性。16周后，跌倒次数、跌倒者和频繁跌倒者分别减少38%、36%和58%，功能（22%-70%）和力量（10%-80%）测试、跌倒效能（11%）和平衡信心（8%）均有显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This feasibility study demonstrates that Aqua Steps aquatic exercise therapy is highly feasible, acceptable, and safe for fall prevention in older adults, and shows preliminary potential for reducing falls and improving function, strength, and balance. These positive findings support larger trials to confirm its efficacy and are valuable for future fall prevention exercise policy development.
items.limitation: 本研究是可行性研究，样本量相对较小，且缺乏长期随访数据，初步结果需在大型RCT中进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a feasibility study with a relatively small sample size and lacks long-term follow-up data; preliminary results require further validation in larger RCTs.

items.title: Association of outpatient waiting time with pain intensity and coping strategies in patients with nonspecific chronic low back pain scheduled for physiotherapy.
items.summary: A prospective observational study (n=60) found outpatient waiting time (OWT) negatively correlated with catastrophizing on arrival (ρ=-0.78, p < .001) in NSCLBP patients. OWT was also associated with patient satisfaction (χ2 = 9.11, p = .028), and while pain increased during OWT, multimodal physiotherapy improved pain and coping strategies.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，门诊等待时间与患者的灾难化思维和婚姻状况相关，并可能影响患者对治疗的满意度。尽管疼痛强度在等待期间可能增加，但多模式物理治疗仍能改善疼痛、灾难化思维和再解释策略。这些发现强调了尽量减少门诊物理治疗等待时间的重要性。
items.titleZh: 门诊等待时间与非特异性慢性腰痛物理治疗患者疼痛强度及应对策略的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察性研究（n=60）发现，在非特异性慢性腰痛患者中，门诊等待时间（OWT）与就诊时的灾难化思维呈负相关（ρ=-0.78, p < .001），并与患者满意度相关（χ2 = 9.11, p = .028）。虽然疼痛强度在等待期间可能增加，但多模式物理治疗能改善疼痛和应对策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that outpatient waiting time is associated with patients' catastrophizing and marital status, and may impact treatment satisfaction. Although pain intensity may increase during waiting, multimodal physiotherapy can still improve pain, catastrophizing, and reinterpretation. These findings highlight the importance of minimizing delays in outpatient physiotherapy visits.
items.limitation: 本研究为前瞻性观察性研究，样本量较小（n=60），可能存在混杂因素，且仅在一个教学医院进行，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a prospective observational study with a small sample size (n=60), potential confounding factors, and limited generalizability as it was conducted at a single teaching hospital.

items.title: How do patients, physiotherapists and orthopedic surgeons perceive delayed recovery during total knee arthroplasty rehabilitation? A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored perceptions of delayed recovery during total knee arthroplasty (TKA) rehabilitation among patients (n=6), physiotherapists (n=6), and orthopedic surgeons (n=5). Patients prioritized pain relief, physiotherapists prioritized physical function, and surgeons prioritized patient satisfaction, highlighting differences in identifying delayed recovery and prognostic factors.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了患者、物理治疗师和骨科医生在全膝关节置换术（TKA）康复延迟的认知上存在差异。临床实践中需要建立关于何时以及如何将TKA康复视为延迟的共识，并关注患者预期作为潜在的治疗目标，以优化康复结果。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术康复期间，患者、物理治疗师和骨科医生如何看待康复延迟？一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了患者（n=6）、物理治疗师（n=6）和骨科医生（n=5）对全膝关节置换术（TKA）康复延迟的看法。研究发现，患者优先关注疼痛缓解，物理治疗师关注身体功能，而外科医生关注患者满意度，揭示了在识别康复延迟和预后因素方面的认知差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals discrepancies in how patients, physiotherapists, and orthopedic surgeons perceive delayed recovery after total knee arthroplasty (TKA). Clinical practice needs consensus on when and how to consider TKA recovery delayed, with patient expectations as a potential treatment target to optimize rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小，且参与者来自特定背景，可能限制了发现的可推广性。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size and participants from specific backgrounds, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: What do physiotherapists need to effectively integrate a biopsychosocial approach in treatment of patients with non-specific low back pain? A qualitative analysis.
items.summary: A qualitative study (n=15 Swiss outpatient physiotherapists) identified four interconnected themes for effectively integrating biopsychosocial approaches in non-specific low back pain treatment: a supportive systemic framework, stronger interdisciplinary collaboration, enhanced educational approaches, and foundational professional attributes.
items.curatedReason: 将生物心理社会方法融入非特异性腰痛治疗，远不只是个人技能问题。这项对15名理疗师的定性研究提示我们，宏观的系统框架、中观的跨学科协作与教育支持，以及微观的专业素质，缺一不可。这意味着推行这一模式时，不能只关注个人培训，更要同步改革系统、促进协作。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗师需要什么才能有效整合生物心理社会方法治疗非特异性腰痛？一项定性分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对15位瑞士门诊物理治疗师的定性研究，确定了在非特异性腰痛治疗中有效整合生物心理社会方法的四个相互关联主题：支持性系统框架、加强跨学科合作、改进教育方法以及核心专业素质。
items.curatedReasonEn: Integrating biopsychosocial approaches for non-specific low back pain is more than just an individual skill set. This qualitative study of 15 physiotherapists suggests that a supportive systemic framework, stronger interdisciplinary collaboration and enhanced educational approaches, alongside foundational professional attributes, are all essential. This implies that promoting this model requires systemic and collaborative reforms, not just individual training.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小（n=15），且仅针对瑞士门诊物理治疗师，结果的普适性有待进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (n=15) and was conducted only among Swiss outpatient physiotherapists, so the generalizability of the findings needs further validation.

items.title: Effects of neuromuscular electrical stimulation applied simultaneously with exercise therapy in patellofemoral pain: A single-blind, randomized, sham-controlled pilot trial.
items.summary: A single-blind, randomized, sham-controlled pilot trial (n=30) found no additional benefit of simultaneous neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) plus exercise therapy versus exercise plus sham for patellofemoral pain. No significant between-group benefits were seen for pain (p = .96), AKPS (p = .26), YBT (p = .28), or quadriceps strength, though total quadriceps muscle thickness increased slightly in the NMES group (p = .03; Cohen's d = -0.27).
items.curatedReason: 本项RCT结果显示，在髌股疼痛（PFP）患者的运动疗法中额外加入同步神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）并未带来额外的短期疼痛缓解或功能改善。虽然股四头肌肌厚略有增加，但临床意义尚不明确。因此，目前不建议常规将NMES作为PFP运动疗法的附加手段。
items.titleZh: 神经肌肉电刺激联合运动疗法治疗髌股疼痛的疗效：一项单盲、随机、假对照初步试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单盲、随机、假对照初步试验（n=30）发现，神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）联合运动疗法对髌股疼痛患者的疼痛（p = .96）、AKPS（p = .26）、YBT（p = .28）或股四头肌力量没有额外益处。尽管NMES组的股四头肌总肌厚略有增加（p = .03; Cohen's d = -0.27），但其临床意义不确定。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that adding simultaneous neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) to exercise therapy for patellofemoral pain (PFP) did not yield additional short-term pain relief or functional improvement. While quadriceps muscle thickness showed a small increase, its clinical relevance is uncertain. Therefore, routine addition of NMES to PFP exercise therapy is not supported.
items.limitation: 本研究是一项小型初步试验（n=30），随访时间短，可能无法检测到小效应量或长期益处。
items.limitationEn: This is a small pilot trial (n=30) with a short follow-up period, which may not detect small effect sizes or long-term benefits.

items.title: Who am I now? Experienced changes of occupational identity after spinal cord injury.
items.summary: A qualitative interview study (n=6 adults with SCI) explored the experiences of redeveloping occupational identity after spinal cord injury. Findings indicated uncertainty and a dynamic process captured by the theme "Landing or not landing in a new identity," highlighting the tension between holding on to a pre-injury identity and allowing a new one to emerge.
items.curatedReason: 本项定性研究强调了脊髓损伤（SCI）患者职业认同再发展的动态性和不确定性，以及支持这一过程的人本康复、协调干预和终生随访的重要性。它提醒临床医师，应关注患者在SCI后自我价值和叙事探索，以更好地支持其职业认同发展。
items.titleZh: “我现在是谁？”脊髓损伤后职业认同的变化体验
items.summaryZh: 一项定性访谈研究（n=6名脊髓损伤成人）探讨了脊髓损伤后职业认同再发展的经历。研究发现，这一过程充满不确定性和动态性，被主题“降落或未降落在新身份中”所概括，凸显了在保留损伤前身份和允许新身份出现之间的张力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights the dynamic and uncertain process of occupational identity redevelopment in spinal cord injury (SCI) patients, and the importance of person-centered rehabilitation, coordinated interventions, and lifelong follow-up to support this process. It reminds clinicians to focus on patients' self-worth and narrative exploration after SCI to better support their occupational identity development.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小（n=6），结果主要反映受访者的个人经验，可能不具普适性。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (n=6), and the results primarily reflect the personal experiences of the interviewees, which may not be universally applicable.

items.title: Power of Functional Mobility Tests in Predicting Fall Risk Among Older Adults.
items.summary: A prospective observational cohort study found TUG (AUC = 0.777) and FSST (AUC = 0.771) had the highest discrimination for predicting falls. Only TUG remained significant in the multivariable model (OR = 1.26 per second; 95% CI: 1.08-1.47). Combining tests with fall history improved model fit (bootstrap-corrected AUC 0.89-0.97).
items.curatedReason: 本前瞻性研究指出，在预测社区居住老年人跌倒风险方面，Timed Up and Go Test（TUG）和Four Square Step Test（FSST）表现出最高的区分度，但单一测试的独立预测能力不足。临床实践中，功能性测试可作为跌倒史筛查的补充工具，而非替代，尤其TUG在多变量模型中仍有显著关联。
items.titleZh: 功能性活动度测试预测老年人跌倒风险的能力
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察性队列研究发现，TUG（AUC = 0.777）和FSST（AUC = 0.771）在预测跌倒方面具有最高的区分度。只有TUG在多变量模型中仍显著相关（OR = 1.26/秒；95% CI: 1.08-1.47）。将功能测试与跌倒史结合可改善模型拟合度（bootstrap校正后的AUC 0.89-0.97）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective study indicates that the Timed Up and Go Test (TUG) and Four Square Step Test (FSST) show the highest discrimination for predicting fall risk in community-dwelling older adults, but no single test is sufficiently strong as a standalone predictor. In clinical practice, functional tests can complement, rather than replace, fall history screening, with TUG showing significant association in multivariable models.
items.limitation: 本研究的样本量相对较小，且随访期为6个月，未能评估长期跌倒风险。研究结果的普适性及结合测试与跌倒史模型的外部验证有待进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: The study has a relatively small sample size and a 6-month follow-up, not assessing long-term fall risk. The generalizability of findings and external validation of combined test and fall history models require further research.

items.title: A Qualitative Study Investigating Sex Differences in the Needs and Priorities of Lower Limb Prosthesis Users
items.summary: A qualitative study interviewed 18 lower limb prosthesis users (9 female, 9 male) to investigate sex differences in their needs and priorities. Themes emerged in prosthetic, physical, psychosocial, and financial experiences, with sex differences observed in all but the financial category, highlighting female-specific challenges in prosthetic fit, ambulation, and psychosocial aspects like frustrations with clinicians and concerns regarding maternity.
items.curatedReason: 本项定性研究揭示了下肢假肢使用者在需求和优先事项方面存在性别差异，尤其在假肢适配、行走挑战和心理社会经历方面。这些发现为未来的性别特异性康复和假肢设计提供了重要依据，提示临床实践中应更关注女性假肢使用者的独特需求，以提供个性化的康复护理。
items.titleZh: 一项调查下肢假肢使用者需求和优先事项性别差异的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究访谈了18位下肢假肢使用者（9名女性，9名男性），以调查其需求和优先事项的性别差异。研究在假肢、身体、心理社会和经济经验中发现了主题，除经济方面外，其余均存在性别差异，凸显了女性在假肢适配、行走以及对临床医生的不满和对生育的担忧等心理社会方面的独特挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals sex differences in the needs and priorities of lower limb prosthesis users, particularly concerning prosthetic fit, ambulation challenges, and psychosocial experiences. These findings provide a crucial basis for future sex-specific rehabilitation and prosthetic design, suggesting that clinical practice should pay more attention to the unique needs of female prosthesis users to provide individualized rehabilitation care.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小（9名女性，9名男性），结果的普适性需更多量化研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (9 females, 9 males), and the generalizability of its findings requires validation through more quantitative research.

items.summary: This is a response to a letter to the editor regarding a qualitative study on barriers and facilitators of decision-making in home-based rehabilitation exercise among older adults following total knee arthroplasty.
