items.title: A meta-analysis of 8 RCTs (n=2548) on extended window IVT (4.
items.summary: A meta-analysis of 8 RCTs (n=2548) on extended window IVT (4.5-24 hours) for acute ischemic stroke found IVT significantly increased the odds of 90-day mRS 0-1 (OR 1.45, 95% CI 1.23-1.72). It also increased early neurological improvement (OR 1.59) but did not significantly improve 90-day mRS 0-2.
items.curatedReason: 这项纳入 8 个 RCT、2548 名患者的荟萃分析明确指出，在急性缺血性卒中发作 4.5 至 24 小时内进行静脉溶栓（IVT），可显著提高患者 90 天良好功能预后（mRS 0-1）的几率（OR 1.45）。你可以更有信心地考虑为符合条件的、处于延长时间窗的患者推荐 IVT 治疗。
items.titleZh: 急性缺血性卒中延长时间窗溶栓（4.5-24 小时）：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 8 项急性缺血性卒中延长时间窗静脉溶栓（4.5-24 小时）随机对照试验（n=2548）的荟萃分析发现，静脉溶栓显著增加了 90 天改良 Rankin 量表 0-1 分的几率（OR 1.45, 95% CI 1.23-1.72）。它也增加了早期神经功能改善（OR 1.59），但对 90 天改良 Rankin 量表 0-2 分无显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-analysis of 8 RCTs, involving 2548 patients, clearly indicates that intravenous thrombolysis (IVT) administered 4.5 to 24 hours after acute ischemic stroke onset significantly increases the odds of excellent functional outcome (mRS 0-1) at 90 days (OR 1.45). You can recommend IVT with more confidence for eligible patients within the extended time window.
items.limitation: 荟萃分析主要基于汇总数据，且纳入试验中大部分使用了组织不匹配影像学筛选患者，可能限制结果对所有卒中患者的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The meta-analysis primarily used aggregate data, and most included trials used tissue mismatch imaging for patient selection, which may limit the generalizability of results to all stroke patients.

items.title: VRCycle: A Feasibility Randomized Controlled Trial Evaluating a Virtual Reality Cycling Intervention in People With Knee Osteoarthritis.
items.summary: A feasibility RCT (n=41) found that VR-enhanced cycling for knee osteoarthritis achieved all feasibility criteria, with 91% adherence and rare technical issues (3%). Clinical outcomes improved in both VR and traditional cycling groups.
items.curatedReason: 虚拟现实骑行对膝关节骨关节炎的疼痛和功能改善与传统骑行无显著差异，但因高依从性和低技术障碍，此干预模式值得进一步开展大规模 RCT。
items.titleZh: VRCycle：一项评估虚拟现实骑行干预对膝关节骨关节炎患者影响的可行性随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对膝关节骨关节炎患者（n=41）进行的可行性随机对照试验显示，虚拟现实增强骑行达到了所有可行性标准，依从性达 91%，技术问题发生率低至 3%。与传统骑行组一样，临床结局均有改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Virtual reality cycling shows comparable improvements in pain and function for knee osteoarthritis to traditional cycling. Its high adherence and low technical issues suggest feasibility for larger RCTs.
items.limitation: 这是一项可行性研究，样本量小，未能评估干预措施的长期疗效。
items.limitationEn: This feasibility study had a small sample size and was not powered to evaluate long-term efficacy.

items.title: Impact of Rehabilitation Initiation Timing on Safety and Efficacy in Patients With Acute Stroke and Concurrent Heart Failure.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (n=9827) found very early rehabilitation (admission day or day 1) for acute stroke patients with heart failure was not associated with increased major adverse events. It was linked to a lower risk of in-hospital respiratory failure (RR=0.58) and 90-day stroke readmission (RR=0.33), and a higher discharge Barthel Index (mean difference=3.66) compared to delayed rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 卒中合并心力衰竭患者通常康复启动较晚。这项观察性研究表明，极早期康复（住院当日或次日）不仅安全，且与更好的巴氏指数和更低的再入院风险相关，提示我们应更积极地评估患者的早期康复潜力。
items.titleZh: 卒中合并心力衰竭患者康复启动时机对安全性和疗效的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（n=9827）发现，对于急性卒中合并心力衰竭的患者，极早期康复（入院当日或次日）并未增加主要不良事件风险。与延迟康复相比，极早期康复与院内呼吸衰竭（RR=0.58）和 90 天卒中再入院（RR=0.33）风险降低，以及出院时巴氏指数（平均差=3.66）提高有关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Rehabilitation for stroke patients with heart failure is often delayed. This observational study indicates that very early rehabilitation (on admission day or day 1) is safe and associated with better Barthel Index scores and lower readmission risk, suggesting a more proactive approach to early rehabilitation potential.
items.limitation: 作为一项回顾性观察研究，无法证明因果关系，且可能存在未调整的混杂因素，如患者的疾病严重程度和康复强度信息不足。
items.limitationEn: As a retrospective observational study, it cannot prove causality and may have unadjusted confounders, such as insufficient information on patient severity and rehabilitation intensity.

items.title: From Referral to Reality: A Mixed Methods Analysis of Barriers to Pediatric Rehabilitation Service Initiation.
items.summary: A mixed-methods study (n=8533 referrals, 12 parent interviews) found only 42.7% of pediatric rehabilitation referrals initiated services. Barriers included geographic availability, scheduling, provider communication, prior rehab experience, family priorities, financial issues, transportation, and a "wait and see" approach.
items.curatedReason: 儿科康复服务启动率低（仅 42.7%），这提示你所在的机构和地区可能也存在类似的患者依从性障碍。解决地理可及性、排程困难和医患沟通问题是提高服务启动率的关键。
items.titleZh: 从转诊到现实：儿科康复服务启动障碍的混合方法分析
items.summaryZh: 一项混合方法研究（8533 例转诊，12 场家长访谈）发现，仅有 42.7% 的儿科康复转诊启动了服务。障碍因素包括地理可及性、排程、提供者沟通、既往康复经验、家庭优先事项、财务问题、交通以及“观望”态度。
items.curatedReasonEn: The low initiation rate (only 42.7%) for pediatric rehabilitation services suggests that similar patient adherence barriers might exist in your own practice. Addressing geographic accessibility, scheduling challenges, and provider-patient communication are key to improving service initiation rates.
items.limitation: 本研究为混合方法设计，其中定量部分为回顾性分析，可能存在选择偏倚和混杂因素；定性部分样本量较小（12 位家长）。
items.limitationEn: This mixed-methods study, with a retrospective quantitative analysis, may have selection bias and confounders; the qualitative component had a small sample size (12 parents).
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Manual techniques for headache: who delivers what and where? A systematic review of randomized controlled trials with a practice-mapping analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review of 35 RCTs on manual techniques for headache found high-velocity, low-amplitude spinal manipulation was predominant (60%), mainly for tension-type (40%) and cervicogenic (29%) headaches. Practice mapping showed no association between technique and headache type (p=0.453) but significant associations with professional background (V=0.54, p=0.044), departmental setting (V=0.77, p=0.0012), and geographic localization (V=0.853, p<0.001).
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述强调，头痛的手法治疗实践受限于治疗师背景、机构设置和地理区域，而非基于标准化诊断。这提示你，目前手法治疗在头痛管理中的应用还缺乏统一的循证指导，需要更多高质量研究。
items.titleZh: 头痛的手法技术：谁在何处提供何种服务？一项带有实践映射分析的随机对照试验系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 35 项头痛手法技术随机对照试验的系统综述发现，高速低幅脊柱推拿是主要技术（60%），主要用于紧张性头痛（40%）和颈源性头痛（29%）。实践映射分析显示，技术与头痛类型无关联（p=0.453），但与专业背景（V=0.54, p=0.044）、科室设置（V=0.77, p=0.0012）和地理位置（V=0.853, p<0.001）显著相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review highlights that manual therapy practice for headaches is shaped by practitioner background, institutional setting, and geographic context, rather than standardized diagnosis. This suggests that current manual therapy application in headache management lacks uniform evidence-based guidance, necessitating more high-quality research.
items.limitation: 纳入的 35 项 RCT 在方法学和报告标准上可能存在异质性，影响了实践映射分析的深度。
items.limitationEn: The 35 included RCTs may have methodological and reporting heterogeneities, affecting the depth of practice-mapping analysis.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Diagnostic Precision in Arthrogenic Muscle Inhibition
items.summary: This current opinion piece argues that arthrogenic muscle inhibition (AMI) is a specific neurophysiological condition defined by spinal reflex inhibition, not a blanket term for quadriceps dysfunction after knee injury. It advocates for mechanistic confirmation for AMI diagnosis, suggesting descriptive terms like "voluntary activation failure" if mechanisms are not measured.
items.curatedReason: 关节源性肌肉抑制（AMI）的诊断常被滥用，这项观点文章提醒我们，AMI 具有特异的神经生理机制，不应将所有膝关节损伤后的股四头肌功能障碍都归结于此。你必须寻求机制性确认，以避免误导治疗选择。
items.titleZh: 关节源性肌肉抑制的诊断精确性
items.summaryZh: 这篇观点文章指出，关节源性肌肉抑制（AMI）是一种由脊柱反射抑制定义的特定神经生理状况，并非膝关节损伤后股四头肌功能障碍的统称。文章主张对 AMI 诊断进行机制性确认，如果未测量机制，则建议使用“自主激活失败”等描述性术语。
items.curatedReasonEn: The diagnosis of arthrogenic muscle inhibition (AMI) is often misused. This opinion piece reminds us that AMI has specific neurophysiological mechanisms, and not all quadriceps dysfunction after knee injury should be attributed to it. You must seek mechanistic confirmation to avoid misdirecting treatment choices.

items.title: Prepaid Physical Therapy Models
items.summary: APTA issued a practice advisory on prepaid physical therapy models (concierge, subscription, bundled services) as of November 2026. These models address persistent payment pressures and administrative burdens, offering alternatives to third-party reimbursement for PT services.
items.curatedReason: 随着支付压力和行政复杂性的增加，预付费物理治疗模式（如礼宾、订阅制、预付费捆绑服务）日益受到关注。APTA 的这份指南为你提供在患者直接支付模式下执业的最新考量，有助于你探索和规划新的营收途径。
items.titleZh: 预付费物理治疗模式 | APTA
items.summaryZh: APTA 于 2026 年 11 月发布了一份关于预付费物理治疗模式（礼宾、订阅、捆绑服务）的执业建议。这些模式旨在应对持续存在的支付压力和行政负担，为物理治疗服务提供第三方报销的替代方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: Amid increasing payment pressures and administrative complexity, prepaid physical therapy models (e.g., concierge, subscription, bundled services) are gaining traction. This APTA advisory offers current considerations for practicing under patient-direct payment models, helping you explore and plan new revenue streams.

items.title: Direct Access By State
items.summary: APTA updated its resource on direct access to physical therapist services in all 50 US states, DC, and the U.S. Virgin Islands, as of November 2026. It outlines the varying levels of direct access provisions and limitations across jurisdictions.
items.curatedReason: 这份 APTA 的最新资源是了解美国各州物理治疗师直接准入法规的权威指南。它直接指出各州对直接准入的规定和限制，对规划你的执业范围、管理患者转诊路径至关重要，你务必查阅你所在州的最新规定。
items.titleZh: 各州直接准入情况 | APTA
items.summaryZh: APTA 更新了截至 2026 年 11 月美国 50 个州、哥伦比亚特区和美属维尔京群岛物理治疗师服务直接准入的资源。它概述了各司法管辖区直接准入规定的不同水平和限制。
items.curatedReasonEn: This updated APTA resource is the definitive guide to direct access laws for physical therapists across the U.S. It directly outlines each state's provisions and limitations for direct access, which is crucial for planning your scope of practice and managing patient referral pathways. You must consult the latest regulations for your state.

items.title: Physiotherapists' experiences of managing turning difficulties in Parkinson's disease: a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 14 UK physiotherapists on Parkinson's disease turning difficulties revealed themes including: recognizing turning as complex, navigating assessment constraints (clinic-to-home gap), adaptive treatment, and system-level barriers like limited evidence and professional isolation.
items.curatedReason: 帕金森病患者的转身困难在临床中被认为是一个重要但未充分解决的问题。这项定性研究提示，现有评估工具和循证方案的缺乏是物理治疗师面临的主要障碍。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗师管理帕金森病转身困难的经验：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 14 名英国物理治疗师就帕金森病转身困难管理经验的定性研究发现，关键主题包括：认识到转身的复杂性、评估限制（诊所与居家表现差距）、适应性治疗方法以及系统性障碍（如证据不足和专业孤立）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Turning difficulties in Parkinson's disease are seen as a significant but underserved issue in clinical practice. This qualitative study highlights that a lack of validated assessment tools and evidence-based protocols are key barriers for physical therapists.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，结果基于访谈中的主观感知而非客观数据，且主要集中于英国的物理治疗师。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study relies on subjective perceptions from interviews rather than objective data, and focused mainly on UK-based physiotherapists.

items.title: Effects of an exercise prescription system (ACTIVE) on physical function in community-dwelling older adults: protocol for a single-centre, assessor-blinded, parallel-group randomised controlled trial
items.summary: This protocol outlines a single-center, assessor-blinded, parallel-group RCT (n=142 older adults) evaluating an AI-based exercise decision-making program (ACTIVE) versus a standardized program over 8 weeks. The primary outcome is a composite physical function Z-score at week 8.
items.curatedReason: 这是一项针对 142 名老年人的 AI 运动处方 RCT 方案。虽然只是协议，但它为居家康复和健康老龄化领域带来了新思路。我们应持续关注该研究的最终结果，以判断 AI 在物理治疗中的实际效用。
items.titleZh: 运动处方系统（ACTIVE）对社区老年人身体机能影响：一项单中心、评估者盲法、平行组随机对照试验方案
items.summaryZh: 本协议描述了一项单中心、评估者盲法、平行组随机对照试验（n=142 名老年人），旨在评估基于人工智能的运动决策程序（ACTIVE）与标准化程序在 8 周内对老年人身体机能的影响。主要结局指标是第 8 周时的综合身体机能 Z 值。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is a protocol for an AI-based exercise prescription RCT involving 142 older adults. While only a protocol, it introduces a novel approach for home-based rehabilitation and healthy aging. We should closely follow the final results to determine the actual utility of AI in physical therapy.
items.limitation: 本研究设计为单中心、8 周干预期，且无法对参与者和干预提供者进行盲法，可能存在表演偏倚和预期偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This study is a single-center, 8-week intervention with unblinded participants and intervention providers, potentially introducing performance and expectation bias.

items.title: Defining Constructs of Hand Function Quality at Home After Cervical Spinal Cord Injury Through Egocentric Videos: A Qualitative Inquiry
items.summary: A qualitative study used focus groups (N=17, including individuals with cSCI, physicians, therapists, researchers) to define constructs of hand function quality in unconstrained, in-home activities after cervical spinal cord injury. 14 categories and 33 constructs were identified.
items.curatedReason: 颈脊髓损伤患者居家手功能评估的质量概念框架对于开发新的真实世界功能指标至关重要。这篇定性研究定义了 14 个类别和 33 个构念，将直接指导你进行更客观、更贴近患者真实生活的手功能评估。
items.titleZh: 通过自我中心视频定义颈脊髓损伤后居家手功能质量的构念：一项定性探究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究通过焦点小组（N=17，包括颈脊髓损伤患者、医生、治疗师和研究人员）定义了颈脊髓损伤后居家非受限活动中手功能质量的构念。共识别出 14 个类别和 33 个构念。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study defining 14 categories and 33 constructs for assessing hand function quality in-home after cervical spinal cord injury is crucial for developing new real-world functional metrics. It will directly guide you in creating more objective, patient-relevant hand function assessments.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，通过焦点小组获取的构念可能存在参与者偏倚，且尚需进一步验证这些构念的客观性和可测量性。
items.limitationEn: As a qualitative study, the constructs derived from focus groups may have participant bias, and further validation is needed for their objectivity and measurability.

items.title: Association between internal training load and overuse injuries in professional sabre fencers: a prospective cohort study
items.summary: A prospective cohort study (n=14 fencers, 497 athlete-weeks) found higher cumulative sRPE workload categories (2-week: OR=2.11; 3-week: OR=2.36; 4-week: OR=2.76) were associated with greater odds of subsequent substantial overuse problems in fencers without prior problems.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性队列研究发现，职业佩剑运动员累积训练负荷越高，后续周内出现过度使用损伤的几率越大。在制定训练计划时，应密切监测运动员的累积负荷，以预防过度训练。
items.titleZh: 内部训练负荷与职业佩剑运动员过度使用损伤之间的关联：一项前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性队列研究（n=14 名击剑运动员，497 个运动员周）发现，在没有前期问题的运动员中，较高的累积 sRPE 训练负荷类别（2 周：OR=2.11；3 周：OR=2.36；4 周：OR=2.76）与后续出现显著过度使用问题的几率增加相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study found that higher cumulative training loads in professional sabre fencers were associated with greater odds of subsequent overuse injuries. When planning training, you should closely monitor cumulative load to prevent overtraining.
items.limitation: 本研究为单支队伍小样本量（14 名击剑运动员），且未调整混杂因素，不能建立因果关系，结果外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This study had a small sample size from a single team (14 fencers) and did not adjust for confounders, thus causality cannot be established, and generalizability is limited.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: A robotic neck exoskeleton for children with poor head control: a feasibility study
items.summary: A feasibility study (n=5 children with poor head control) evaluated a robotic neck exoskeleton in a school setting. The system was well-tolerated, improved head control and task performance, and increased the contribution of head twist to overall rotation (from 40.4% to 65.3-66.7%) while maintaining substantial sternocleidomastoid activation.
items.curatedReason: 儿童颈部外骨骼机器人初步验证了其在改善头部控制方面的可行性和即时生物力学效果。这为未来针对严重运动障碍儿童的康复干预提供了新的技术方向，尤其值得你在技术辅助康复领域关注。
items.titleZh: 一种用于头部控制能力差儿童的机器人颈部外骨骼：一项可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项可行性研究（n=5 名头部控制能力差的儿童）评估了在学校环境中使用机器人颈部外骨骼。该系统耐受性良好，改善了头部控制和任务表现，并增加了头部扭转对总体旋转的贡献（从 40.4% 增至 65.3-66.7%），同时保持胸锁乳突肌的显著激活。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study validates the feasibility and immediate biomechanical effects of a robotic neck exoskeleton in improving head control in children. This offers a new technological direction for rehabilitation interventions targeting children with severe motor disabilities, particularly relevant for those focused on technology-assisted rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量极小（N=5），且仅评估了短期即时效果，未能探讨长期使用对发育和功能的全面影响。
items.limitationEn: This study had an extremely small sample size (N=5) and only evaluated immediate short-term effects, without exploring the comprehensive long-term impact on development and function.

items.title: Prognostic factors and prognostic models for recovery and treatment response in patients with painful cervical radiculopathy: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review of 7 studies on painful cervical radiculopathy found limited evidence (very low to moderate certainty) for prognostic factors and models. Only one model was internally validated, and none were externally validated, making their clinical implementation unsupported.
items.curatedReason: 对于有症状性颈椎神经根病患者的预后因素和治疗反应预测模型，目前证据仍十分有限且质量较低。在将任何预测模型应用于临床实践前，务必等待外部验证研究。
items.titleZh: 疼痛性颈椎神经根病患者康复和治疗反应的预后因素和预测模型：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 7 项疼痛性颈椎神经根病研究的系统综述发现，预后因素和预测模型的证据有限（确定性极低至中等）。仅有一个模型进行了内部验证，且所有模型均未进行外部验证，因此不支持其临床应用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Evidence for prognostic factors and predictive models for recovery and treatment response in patients with painful cervical radiculopathy is currently limited and of low quality. You must await external validation studies before implementing any predictive model in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 纳入的七项研究中，大多数存在高风险偏倚，且所有预测模型均未经过外部验证，限制了其临床应用价值。
items.limitationEn: Most of the seven included studies had a high risk of bias, and none of the predictive models were externally validated, limiting their clinical applicability.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Ahpra secures first ever conviction for misuse of the title ‘surgeon’
items.summary: Ahpra secured its first conviction against a Sydney cosmetic doctor, Adam Najem, for unlawfully using the title "surgeon" in advertising since national law changes in September 2023. He was sentenced to an eight-month Community Corrections Order and fined $12,000.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局 (Ahpra) 首次成功起诉并定罪冒用“外科医生”头衔的医生。这起案件坐实了澳大利亚在规范医疗执业头衔上的决心，提示你在澳大利亚执业时必须严格遵守头衔使用规定。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局——Ahpra 首次成功起诉并定罪冒用“外科医生”头衔者
items.summaryZh: 自 2023 年国家法律修改后，澳大利亚健康从业者监管局 (Ahpra) 首次成功起诉并定罪悉尼美容医生 Adam Najem，罪名是在广告中非法使用“外科医生”头衔。他被判处八个月社区矫正令并罚款 12,000 澳元。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) has successfully prosecuted and convicted a doctor for the first time for misusing the title "surgeon." This case solidifies Australia's commitment to regulating professional titles, reminding you to strictly adhere to title usage regulations when practicing in Australia.

items.title: Reliability and responsiveness of breathing pattern – a narrative review
items.summary: This narrative review summarizes existing literature on the reliability and responsiveness of breathing patterns as a potential outcome measure in respiratory physiotherapy. It highlights the lack of an agreed-upon definition for "breathing pattern" and insufficient validated and reliable outcome measures in the field.
items.curatedReason: 呼吸模式的可靠性和反应性对于呼吸物理治疗的循证实践至关重要。这篇综述提醒我们，目前对呼吸模式的定义和测量方法缺乏统一标准，导致其作为结局指标的临床应用仍存在障碍。
items.titleZh: 呼吸模式的可靠性和反应性——一项叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述总结了关于呼吸模式作为呼吸物理治疗潜在结局指标的可靠性和反应性文献。它强调了“呼吸模式”定义缺乏共识以及该领域缺乏经过验证且可靠的结局测量工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: The reliability and responsiveness of breathing patterns are crucial for evidence-based respiratory physical therapy. This review highlights that the lack of standardized definitions and measurement methods for breathing patterns currently hinders its clinical utility as an outcome measure.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且未进行系统性文献检索和质量评估。
items.limitationEn: This narrative review may have selection bias and did not conduct a systematic literature search or quality assessment.
items.journal: Bulletin of Faculty of Physical Therapy

items.title: The effect of music therapy on function in people with Parkinson's disease or parkinsonism: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of studies (3635 patients) found music therapy significantly improved athletic function (SMD = -0.53), balance (SMD = 0.45), gait (SMD = 0.59), depression (SMD = -0.76), anxiety (SMD = -0.59), sleep quality (SMD = -0.76), cognitive function (SMD = -0.90), and swallowing function (SMD = -1.35) in people with Parkinson's disease.
items.curatedReason: 这份大样本系统综述和荟萃分析确证了音乐疗法对帕金森病患者运动功能、平衡、步态以及抑郁、焦虑、睡眠、认知和吞咽功能有显著改善。这些效应量均达到临床意义，表明音乐疗法应被纳入帕金森病的康复方案。
items.titleZh: 音乐疗法对帕金森病或帕金森综合征患者功能的影响：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含研究的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，音乐疗法显著改善了帕金森病患者的运动功能 (SMD = -0.53)、平衡 (SMD = 0.45)、步态 (SMD = 0.59)，以及抑郁 (SMD = -0.76)、焦虑 (SMD = -0.59)、睡眠质量 (SMD = -0.76)、认知功能 (SMD = -0.90) 和吞咽功能 (SMD = -1.35)。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large-sample systematic review and meta-analysis confirms that music therapy significantly improves motor function, balance, gait, depression, anxiety, sleep, cognition, and swallowing in Parkinson's disease patients. The effect sizes are clinically meaningful, indicating music therapy should be integrated into Parkinson's rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的普遍质量良好，但未提及是否存在异质性或出版偏倚对效应量的影响。
items.limitationEn: While the included studies are generally of good quality, the review did not explicitly state the impact of heterogeneity or publication bias on the effect sizes.

items.title: Self-guided home-based rehabilitation for upper limb motor recovery in people with stroke: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 14 studies (8 cohorts) on self-guided, home-based rehabilitation (SGHBR) for upper limb recovery in stroke patients found no significant advantage over other interventions, though the pooled estimate slightly favored SGHBR (SMD = 0.10, 95% CI -0.23 to 0.44).
items.curatedReason: 卒中后上肢自我指导居家康复（SGHBR）与常规疗法效果相当，但并未显示出显著优势。这意味着 SGHBR 适合作为常规治疗的补充或替代方案，尤其适用于资源有限或难以频繁就诊的患者。制定康复计划时，可积极推荐 SGHBR 以提高患者依从性和康复可及性。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者上肢运动恢复的自我指导居家康复：系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对卒中患者上肢运动恢复的自我指导居家康复（SGHBR）的系统综述和荟萃分析（14 项研究，8 个独立队列）发现，SGHBR 与其他康复干预相比没有显著优势，但汇总估计略微倾向于 SGHBR (SMD = 0.10, 95% CI -0.23 to 0.44)。
items.curatedReasonEn: Self-guided home-based rehabilitation (SGHBR) for upper limb recovery post-stroke shows comparable efficacy to conventional therapies, though without significant superiority. This makes SGHBR a viable supplementary or alternative option, especially for patients with limited resources or difficulty attending frequent clinic visits. Proactively recommend SGHBR in rehabilitation plans to enhance patient adherence and access to care.
items.limitation: 荟萃分析显示 SGHBR 无显著优势，且需要更高质量的研究来确认其在不同卒中人群中的疗效、普适性和成本效益。
items.limitationEn: The meta-analysis showed no significant advantage for SGHBR, and higher-quality studies are needed to confirm its efficacy, generalizability, and cost-effectiveness across stroke survivor populations.

items.title: Virtual and Augmented Reality Feedback During Robotic Gait Training Acutely Modulate Paretic Muscle Activation, Limb Loading, and Propulsion-Related Mechanics in Chronic Hemiparetic Stroke: A Randomised Crossover Trial.
items.summary: A randomized crossover trial with chronic hemiparetic stroke patients found that VR-RAGT and screen-based AR-RAGT acutely modulated paretic gait mechanics differently, with sequential combined VR + AR producing the broadest modulation of muscle activation, limb loading, and COP progression.
items.curatedReason: 虚拟现实（VR）和增强现实（AR）在机器人辅助步态训练（RAGT）中对卒中偏瘫患者的急性肌激活和负重模式有不同但积极的调节作用。在临床实践中，可以考虑交替使用或结合 VR 和 AR，以期实现更全面的康复效果，但长期疗效仍需验证。
items.titleZh: 慢性偏瘫性卒中患者机器人步态训练中虚拟和增强现实反馈对瘫痪肌肉激活、肢体负荷和推进相关机制的急性调节：一项随机交叉试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对慢性偏瘫性卒中患者的随机交叉试验发现，虚拟现实（VR）和屏幕增强现实（AR）反馈在机器人辅助步态训练（RAGT）中对偏瘫侧步态机制有不同的急性调节作用，而 VR+AR 序贯组合产生了最广泛的肌激活、肢体负荷和压力中心（COP）进展的调节。
items.curatedReasonEn: Virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR) in robot-assisted gait training (RAGT) acutely modulate paretic muscle activation and limb loading differently but positively in chronic hemiparetic stroke patients. Clinically, consider alternating or combining VR and AR to achieve broader rehabilitation effects, though long-term efficacy requires further validation.
items.limitation: 这项随机交叉试验只评估了急性效应，尚不清楚这些急性效应能否转化为长期的功能恢复。
items.limitationEn: This randomized crossover trial only evaluated acute effects, and it remains unclear whether these acute effects translate into long-term functional recovery.

items.title: Application of the ICF in the functioning assessment of children with suspected developmental coordination difficulties.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 208 children found that those with probable DCD showed lower motor skills in the activities domain and lower community involvement in the participation domain compared to typically neurodeveloping children, underscoring the role of physical therapy for improved coordination, balance, and social interaction.
items.curatedReason: 疑似发育性协调障碍（DCD）儿童在活动和参与方面的运动技能和社区融入度确实低于普通儿童，这与其他研究结果一致。这项对 208 名儿童的观察研究再次强调，物理治疗是改善 DCD 儿童协调、平衡和社交互动能力的重要手段，应在评估和干预中整合 ICF 框架。
items.titleZh: ICF 在疑似发育性协调障碍儿童功能评估中的应用
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 208 名儿童的横断面研究发现，与神经发育正常的儿童相比，可能患有发育性协调障碍（p-DCD）的儿童在活动领域表现出较低的运动技能，并在参与领域显示出较低的社区参与度，这强调了物理治疗在改善协调、平衡和社交互动方面的作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Children with probable DCD indeed exhibit lower motor skills in activities and less community involvement than neurotypical children, consistent with prior findings. This observational study of 208 children reiterates that physical therapy is crucial for improving coordination, balance, and social interaction in children with DCD, advocating for an integrated ICF framework in assessment and intervention.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，不能建立因果关系，且可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which cannot establish causality and may be subject to selection bias.

items.title: Thoracic expansion and spirometry 120 days after adding diaphragmatic manual therapy to physiotherapy in non-specific low back pain: Follow-up of a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=50) found that adding manual diaphragmatic stretching to conventional physiotherapy significantly improved inspiratory thoracic expansion (e.g., axillary 3.38 cm) and spirometric values (e.g., FVC 1.57 L) at 120 days in non-specific low back pain patients.
items.curatedReason: 本 RCT 发现，在常规物理治疗中加入膈肌手法治疗，能持续改善非特异性腰痛患者的胸廓扩张和肺活量，效果可维持 120 天。这提示你可以将膈肌手法治疗作为常规物理治疗的有效补充，特别是在评估患者呼吸力学受限时。
items.titleZh: 非特异性腰痛患者在物理治疗中增加膈肌手法治疗后胸廓扩张和肺活量在 120 天后的随访：一项随机对照试验的后续研究
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=50）发现，在非特异性腰痛患者的常规物理治疗中加入膈肌手法治疗，能在 120 天后显著改善吸气性胸廓扩张（例如，腋部 3.38 厘米）和肺活量（例如，FVC 1.57 升）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that adding manual diaphragmatic stretching to conventional physiotherapy consistently improved thoracic expansion and spirometric values in patients with non-specific low back pain, with effects maintained for 120 days. This suggests you can incorporate manual diaphragmatic stretching as an effective complement to conventional physiotherapy, especially when assessing patients with respiratory mechanical limitations.
items.limitation: 研究未对参与者进行盲法，且缺乏假对照组，所用便携式肺活量测定协议可能影响结果的准确性，需在实验室肺活量测定下进行假对照试验确认。
items.limitationEn: The study lacked participant blinding and a sham comparator, and the portable spirometry protocol used might affect the accuracy of the results; confirmation in sham-controlled trials using laboratory spirometry is needed.

items.title: Older Adults and Healthcare Professionals Perspectives on Comfort, Dignity, and Safety During Technology-Assisted Transfers: A Qualitative Descriptive Study
items.summary: A qualitative descriptive study explored perspectives of 15 older adults and 15 healthcare professionals on technology-assisted transfers, revealing that comfort, dignity, and safety are interconnected and co-constructed through interactions, emphasizing relational practices, training, staffing, and adaptable equipment.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了老年人和医护人员在使用技术辅助转移设备时，舒适度、尊严和安全性是相互关联的。作为临床 PT，你应重视转移过程中的沟通、隐私和员工的持续性，并关注技术与关系技能并重的培训，从而提升患者的转移体验，而不仅仅是设备本身。
items.titleZh: 老年人与医护人员对技术辅助转移过程中舒适度、尊严和安全性的看法：一项定性描述性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性描述性研究探讨了 15 名老年人和 15 名医护人员对技术辅助转移的看法，发现舒适度、尊严和安全性是相互关联并通过互动共同构建的，强调了关系实践、培训、人员配备和适应性设备的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals that comfort, dignity, and safety are interconnected during technology-assisted transfers for older adults and healthcare professionals. As a clinical PT, you should prioritize communication, privacy, and staff continuity during transfers, and focus on training that combines technical and relational skills to enhance patient transfer experiences, beyond just the equipment itself.
items.limitation: 这项定性研究是基于参与者的主观感知，其结果可能不具普遍性，且未提供量化数据支持。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study is based on participants' subjective perceptions, and its findings may not be generalizable; it also does not provide quantitative data support.

items.title: Multimodal Prehabilitation in People Awaiting Acute Inpatient Cardiac Surgery (PreP-ACe): A single-arm feasibility study
items.summary: A single-arm feasibility study (n=17) found that multimodal prehabilitation for acute inpatients awaiting cardiac surgery was acceptable, well-tolerated (adherence 100%, tolerability >80%), and feasible, with no adverse events, despite recruitment challenges.
items.curatedReason: 这项可行性研究表明，对急性住院心脏手术患者进行多模式术前康复是可行的、可接受的且依从性高。尽管招募面临挑战，但其初步结果支持在术前等待期间开展个性化运动处方，有助于预防住院相关失能。在临床实践中，可以探索将术前康复纳入急性心脏病住院患者的护理流程。
items.titleZh: 急性住院心脏手术等待患者的多模式术前康复（PreP-ACe）：一项单臂可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项单臂可行性研究（n=17）发现，对等待急性心脏手术的住院患者进行多模式术前康复是可接受、耐受性良好（依从性 100%，耐受性 >80%）且可行的，尽管在招募方面存在挑战，但未记录到不良事件。
items.curatedReasonEn: This feasibility study indicates that multimodal prehabilitation for acute inpatient cardiac surgery patients is feasible, acceptable, and has high adherence. Despite recruitment challenges, preliminary results support personalized exercise prescription during pre-operative waiting to prevent hospital-associated deconditioning. In clinical practice, explore integrating prehabilitation into the care pathway for acute cardiac inpatients.
items.limitation: 这是一项单臂可行性研究，样本量小（17人），缺乏对照组，无法评估干预的疗效，且招募率较低。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-arm feasibility study with a small sample size (17 participants) and no control group, preventing efficacy assessment, and it had a low recruitment rate.

items.title: Validity and Reliability of the Performanz Spark for Measuring Sprint Performance in Young Male Basketball Players
items.summary: This study evaluated the validity and reliability of the Performanz Spark device for measuring sprint performance in young male basketball players.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究验证了 Performanz Spark 设备在测量年轻男性篮球运动员短跑表现方面的有效性和可靠性。如果你在运动康复或体能训练中需要精确量化短跑数据，可以考虑将该设备作为辅助工具，但需结合其他评估方法进行综合判断。
items.titleZh: Performanz Spark 测量年轻男性篮球运动员短跑表现的有效性和可靠性
items.summaryZh: 本研究评估了 Performanz Spark 设备在测量年轻男性篮球运动员短跑表现方面的有效性和可靠性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study validated the Performanz Spark device's efficacy and reliability in measuring sprint performance in young male basketball players. If you need precise sprint data quantification in sports rehabilitation or physical training, consider this device as an auxiliary tool, but integrate it with other assessment methods for comprehensive evaluation.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于年轻男性篮球运动员，其结果可能无法直接推广到其他人群或运动类型。
items.limitationEn: The study was limited to young male basketball players, so its results may not be directly generalizable to other populations or sports.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: Effects of Functional Visuo-Proprioceptive Stimulation on Upper- and Lower-Limb Motor Impairment After Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Crossover Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled crossover trial (N=21) found that functional visuo-proprioceptive stimulation (FPS) was associated with reduced upper-limb (7.22 points FMA-UE improvement) and lower-limb (2.23 points FMA-LE improvement) motor impairment in individuals with subacute stroke, with upper-limb gains reaching clinically important difference ranges.
items.curatedReason: 功能性视觉本体感受刺激（FPS）可能成为亚急性卒中患者康复的有效辅助手段。这项 RCT 证明了其对肢体运动障碍的改善，尤其是上肢，效果可达临床最小重要差异范围。
items.titleZh: 功能性视觉本体感受刺激对卒中后上肢和下肢运动障碍的影响：一项随机对照交叉试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照交叉试验（N=21）发现，功能性视觉本体感受刺激（FPS）与亚急性卒中患者上肢（FMA-UE 改善 7.22 分）和下肢（FMA-LE 改善 2.23 分）运动障碍的减轻相关，其中上肢的改善达到了临床重要差异范围。
items.curatedReasonEn: Functional visuo-proprioceptive stimulation (FPS) could be an effective adjunct in subacute stroke rehabilitation. This RCT demonstrates its improvements in limb motor impairment, particularly for the upper extremity, reaching the minimal clinically important difference range.
items.limitation: 研究为单中心交叉随机对照试验，样本量相对较小（21名完成者），且未评估长期效果。
items.limitationEn: The study was a single-center, crossover RCT with a relatively small sample size (21 completers) and did not assess long-term effects.

items.title: Comparative Efficacy of Low-Level Laser Therapy in Patients With Carpal Tunnel Syndrome: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
items.summary: An updated systematic review and meta-analysis of 16 RCTs found low-level laser therapy (LLLT) significantly reduced pain (Hedges' g=-1.524) and improved grip strength (Hedges' g=0.391) in carpal tunnel syndrome, with pulsed mode superior for analgesia and continuous mode for grip strength.
items.curatedReason: 这份更新的系统综述和荟萃分析坐实了低强度激光治疗（LLLT）对腕管综合征患者疼痛和握力的改善作用。脉冲模式在镇痛方面更优，而连续模式则更有利于功能恢复，这提示临床实践中应根据治疗目标选择合适的激光参数。
items.titleZh: 低强度激光治疗对腕管综合征患者的比较疗效：随机对照试验的更新系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 16 项随机对照试验的更新系统综述和荟萃分析发现，低强度激光治疗（LLLT）显著减轻了腕管综合征患者的疼痛（Hedges' g=-1.524）并改善了握力（Hedges' g=0.391），其中脉冲模式在镇痛方面更优，连续模式则有利于握力改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This updated systematic review and meta-analysis confirms that low-level laser therapy (LLLT) improves pain and grip strength in carpal tunnel syndrome. Pulsed mode is superior for analgesia, while continuous mode favors functional recovery, suggesting parameter selection should align with therapeutic goals in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 虽然是系统综述，但仍需警惕纳入研究的异质性和潜在的发表偏倚。
items.limitationEn: Despite being a systematic review, heterogeneity among included studies and potential publication bias should be considered.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Compensatory Trunk Neuromuscular Control During Early Rehabilitation After Motor Incomplete Spinal Cord Injury.
items.summary: This observational study of 36 individuals with motor incomplete SCI found that trunk neuromuscular control strategies during early rehabilitation (4 weeks) differ based on injury severity, with more severe injuries showing greater caudal shifts in lumbar erector spinae activation patterns.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，脊髓不完全损伤后的躯干神经肌肉控制恢复策略，会因损伤严重程度而异。它支持在早期康复中，结合详细的躯干运动学和高密度表面肌电图来指导更个体化的干预。
items.titleZh: 运动不完全性脊髓损伤早期康复期间的代偿性躯干神经肌肉控制
items.summaryZh: 这项对 36 名运动不完全性脊髓损伤患者的观察性研究发现，早期（4 周）康复期间的躯干神经肌肉控制策略因损伤严重程度而异，其中损伤较重的患者在腰骶竖脊肌激活模式上表现出更大的尾侧偏移。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that trunk neuromuscular control recovery strategies after motor incomplete SCI vary by injury severity. It supports incorporating detailed trunk kinematics and HDsEMG in early rehabilitation to guide more individualized interventions.
items.limitation: 这是一项短期（4周随访）的观察性研究，样本量相对较小（36名SCI患者），结论外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a short-term (4-week follow-up) observational study with a relatively small sample size (36 SCI participants), limiting generalizability.

items.title: Venous flow dynamics in post-stroke hemiparetic lower extremity motor dysfunctions.
items.summary: A retrospective cross-sectional study of 43 hemiparetic stroke patients found significantly reduced venous pump capacity (1.07 ± 0.43% vs. 2.24 ± 0.74%) and venous refilling time (9.26 ± 3.42 s vs. 19.4 ± 2.0 s) in paretic limbs, correlating with motor function and functional independence.
items.curatedReason: 该回顾性横断面研究发现，卒中后偏瘫肢体存在显著的静脉血流障碍，且与运动功能和功能独立性相关。这提示在卒中康复中，应关注静脉评估，以预防血栓栓塞并发症并改善循环结局。
items.titleZh: 卒中后偏瘫下肢运动功能障碍中的静脉血流动力学
items.summaryZh: 一项对 43 名偏瘫卒中患者的回顾性横断面研究发现，偏瘫肢体的静脉泵容量（1.07 ± 0.43% vs. 2.24 ± 0.74%）和静脉再充盈时间（9.26 ± 3.42 秒 vs. 19.4 ± 2.0 秒）显著降低，并与运动功能和功能独立性相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective cross-sectional study found significant venous flow impairment in post-stroke hemiparetic limbs, associated with motor function and functional independence. This suggests venous assessment should be integrated into stroke rehabilitation to prevent thromboembolic complications and improve circulatory outcomes.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective cross-sectional study, unable to establish causality, and may be subject to selection bias.

items.title: Physiological responses during high intensity interval training and moderate intensity continuous training in patients attending early cardiac rehabilitation.
items.summary: A study of 18 coronary artery disease patients in early cardiac rehabilitation found that low-volume high-intensity interval training (HIIT) elicited greater mean VO₂, %VO₂R, time >90% VO₂R, %HRR, RPP, and blood lactate than time-matched moderate-intensity continuous training (MICT), alongside higher perceived exertion (13 ± 1 vs. 11 ± 1).
items.curatedReason: 这项对早期心脏康复患者的研究显示，低容量高强度间歇训练（HIIT）能比时间匹配的中等强度持续训练（MICT）产生更高的生理刺激负荷和感知劳累。这为心脏康复中 HIIT 的个体化处方提供了生理学依据。
items.titleZh: 早期心脏康复患者高强度间歇训练和中等强度持续训练期间的生理反应
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 18 名早期心脏康复冠心病患者的研究发现，低容量高强度间歇训练（HIIT）在平均 VO₂、%VO₂R、>90% VO₂R 时间、%HRR、RPP 和血乳酸方面均高于时间匹配的中等强度持续训练（MICT），同时感知劳累程度更高（13 ± 1 vs. 11 ± 1）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study in early cardiac rehabilitation patients shows that low-volume high-intensity interval training (HIIT) elicits greater physiological stimulus and perceived exertion than time-matched moderate-intensity continuous training (MICT). This provides a physiological basis for individualized HIIT prescription in cardiac rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（18名患者），且为单中心研究，结果推广性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (18 patients) and was single-center, limiting the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: [Correspondence] The Lancet Group's guidance on reporting disability: make link to the ICF explicit
items.summary: This correspondence suggests that The Lancet Group's new guidance on reporting disability should explicitly link to WHO's International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF) to enhance inclusive health research.
items.curatedReason: 这篇通信建议《柳叶刀》集团在残疾报告指南中明确提及 WHO 的国际功能、残疾和健康分类（ICF）。这对于物理治疗师理解和应用残疾的标准化框架，进一步提升研究和临床实践的规范性具有指导意义。
items.titleZh: 《柳叶刀》集团关于残疾报告的指南：明确与 ICF 的联系
items.summaryZh: 这篇通信建议《柳叶刀》集团新的残疾报告指南应明确与世界卫生组织（WHO）的国际功能、残疾和健康分类（ICF）建立联系，以促进包容性健康研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: This correspondence suggests that The Lancet Group explicitly reference WHO's International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF) in its disability reporting guidance. This is instructive for physical therapists in understanding and applying standardized frameworks for disability, further enhancing research and clinical practice rigor.

items.title: Selective distal upper extremity recovery following targeted dentate nucleus temporal interference stimulation in stroke-double-blind, sham-controlled randomized controlled trial with resting-state EEG
items.summary: This double-blind, sham-controlled RCT of 50 subacute stroke patients found active cerebellar dentate nucleus-targeted transcranial temporal interference stimulation (DN-tTIS) combined with rehabilitation significantly improved FMA-UE (adjusted mean difference 3.98 points, p=0.006) and ARAT (adjusted mean difference 2.98 points, p=0.005), primarily driven by distal motor control (d=2.46, p<0.001). No serious adverse events occurred.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，针对小脑齿状核的经颅时间干涉刺激 (tTIS) 能显著改善亚急性卒中患者的上肢运动功能，特别是远端腕手控制。将 tTIS 结合常规康复，可以考虑作为强化卒中患者远端功能恢复的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 卒中后定向齿状核时间干涉刺激对远端上肢选择性恢复的影响：一项双盲、假对照随机对照试验，结合静息态脑电图
items.summaryZh: 这项对 50 名亚急性卒中患者进行的双盲、假对照随机对照试验发现，结合康复的活动性小脑齿状核靶向经颅时间干涉刺激 (DN-tTIS) 显著改善了 FMA-UE (调整后均差 3.98 分, p=0.006) 和 ARAT (调整后均差 2.98 分, p=0.005)，主要由远端运动控制 (d=2.46, p<0.001) 驱动。未发生严重不良事件。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that transcranial temporal interference stimulation (tTIS) targeting the cerebellar dentate nucleus significantly improves upper-extremity motor function, especially distal wrist and hand control, in subacute stroke patients. Consider tTIS combined with conventional rehabilitation as an adjunct to enhance distal function recovery in stroke patients.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且随访时间仅为短期，长期效果和机制仍需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a relatively small sample size and short-term follow-up, so long-term effects and mechanisms require further validation.

items.title: Comparative Effects of Different Neuromuscular Training Modalities and Doses on Lower-Limb Injury Prevention in Athletes: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 27 RCTs (27,663 participants) found neuromuscular training (NMT) associated with reduced lower-limb injury risk (RR = 0.72, 95% CI 0.64–0.82) in athletes. Structured and multidimensional programs showed favorable estimates, particularly in adolescents and young adults. Overall certainty of evidence was very low.
items.curatedReason: 你为运动员设计的训练中，应该考虑加入结构化、多维度的神经肌肉训练（NMT），它可能降低下肢损伤风险 (RR = 0.72)，尤其对青少年和青年成人效果更明显。但请注意，现有证据的总体确定性仍非常低，不可过分解读。
items.titleZh: 不同神经肌肉训练模式和剂量对运动员下肢损伤预防的比较效果：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项对 27 项 RCT（27,663 名受试者）进行的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，神经肌肉训练 (NMT) 与运动员下肢损伤风险降低相关（RR = 0.72，95% CI 0.64–0.82）。结构化和多维度训练方案显示出积极的效果，尤其是在青少年和青年成人中。总体证据确定性非常低。
items.curatedReasonEn: In your athlete training programs, you should consider incorporating structured, multidimensional neuromuscular training (NMT), as it may reduce lower-limb injury risk (RR = 0.72), especially in adolescents and young adults. However, be aware that the overall certainty of evidence remains very low, so do not overinterpret these findings.
items.limitation: 总体证据确定性非常低，且剂量与反应关系尚未确立因果。
items.limitationEn: The overall certainty of evidence is very low, and dose-response relationships have not established causality.

items.title: Body-weight support is the dominant contributor to elevated walking cost in cerebral palsy
items.summary: This study of 23 children with cerebral palsy (CP) and 10 typically developing peers found body-weight support significantly reduced net energetic cost, with a 3.5-fold greater effect in the CP group. Energetic cost in CP decreased by 41% to a level similar to typically developing participants, identifying gravitational support as a key biomechanical target.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，在脑瘫儿童中，体重支持是导致步行能量消耗增加的主要因素。这为康复干预提供了明确的生物力学靶点，提示物理治疗师应优先关注通过减少重力支持需求来优化步行效率。
items.titleZh: 体重支持是脑瘫儿童步行成本升高的主要原因
items.summaryZh: 这项对 23 名脑瘫 (CP) 儿童和 10 名典型发育同龄儿童的研究发现，体重支持显著降低了净能量消耗，在 CP 组中的效果高出 3.5 倍。CP 组的能量消耗降低了 41%，达到与典型发育参与者相似的水平，表明重力支持是关键的生物力学目标。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that body-weight support is the dominant contributor to elevated walking cost in children with cerebral palsy. This identifies a clear biomechanical target for rehabilitation interventions, suggesting physical therapists should prioritize optimizing walking efficiency by reducing gravitational support demands.
items.limitation: 研究是在固定非维度速度的跑步机上进行的，其结果可能无法完全推广到实际的自由行走环境。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted on a treadmill at a fixed non-dimensional speed, and results may not fully generalize to real-world free-walking environments.

items.title: Aerobic and aerobic–cognitive training in knee osteoarthritis following acute exercise intensity selection: a two-phase randomised controlled trial protocol
items.summary: This two-phase randomized controlled trial protocol aims to select an optimal aerobic exercise intensity for knee osteoarthritis (KOA) patients and evaluate the effectiveness of aerobic and aerobic-cognitive training against physical-agent therapy, with a planned recruitment of 108 participants. The primary outcome is average knee pain at 12 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 这项纳入 108 人的两阶段 RCT 方案，重点在于确定膝骨关节炎患者有氧运动的最佳强度，并对比单独有氧训练与有氧认知结合训练的效果。如果结果积极，它将为我们优化 KOA 运动处方提供具体指导，告诉你该如何为患者选择合适的运动强度与模式。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎急性运动强度选择后的有氧和有氧认知训练：一项两阶段随机对照试验方案
items.summaryZh: 这项两阶段随机对照试验方案旨在确定膝骨关节炎患者有氧运动的最佳强度，并评估有氧和有氧认知训练与物理疗法相比的疗效，计划招募 108 名受试者。主要结局指标是 12 周时的平均膝关节疼痛。
items.curatedReasonEn: This 108-participant, two-phase RCT protocol focuses on identifying the optimal aerobic exercise intensity for KOA patients and comparing aerobic-cognitive training against aerobic-only training. If successful, it will offer specific guidance on how to optimize exercise prescriptions for KOA, informing your choices for intensity and modality.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心试验，可能限制结果的外部有效性和推广性。
items.limitationEn: The study is a single-center trial, which may limit the external validity and generalizability of the results.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Prevalence and Associated Factors of Pelvic Floor Dysfunction in Women Who Practice CrossFit®: A Systematic Review
items.summary: This systematic review of 16 cross-sectional and two case-control studies investigated pelvic floor dysfunction prevalence in female CrossFit practitioners. It found urinary incontinence rates from 14.5% to 84%, with longer CrossFit practice, higher intensity, and jump rope exercises associated with increased risk.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述强调了 CrossFit 训练女性盆底功能障碍的高患病率，特别是尿失禁。它指出了训练时间、强度和高冲击练习（如跳绳）与症状之间的关联，提示临床医生应在为从事这类运动的女性提供咨询时考虑这些风险因素。
items.titleZh: CrossFit® 训练女性盆底功能障碍的患病率及相关因素：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述纳入了 16 项横断面研究和 2 项病例对照研究，调查了 CrossFit 训练女性盆底功能障碍的患病率。结果显示，尿失禁的患病率从 14.5% 到 84% 不等，且 CrossFit 训练时间越长、强度越高以及跳绳练习与风险增加相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review highlights the high prevalence of pelvic floor dysfunction, particularly urinary incontinence, among women who practice CrossFit. It points to associations between longer practice duration, higher intensity, and high-impact exercises like jump rope, suggesting clinicians should consider these risk factors when counseling women engaged in such sports.
items.limitation: 纳入的研究多为横断面设计，难以确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The included studies were predominantly cross-sectional, making it difficult to establish causality.

items.title: A systematic review of robotic hip exoskeletons for gait rehabilitation: from design to clinical evidence
items.summary: This systematic review of 19 human subject studies on robotic hip exoskeletons for gait rehabilitation found reported improvements in walking speed, step length, and symmetry. Bilateral assistance and adaptive control strategies were frequently used in studies showing favorable outcomes, though long-term clinical impact remains limited.
items.curatedReason: 这篇系统综述综合了髋部外骨骼机器人在步态康复中的应用证据，指出其在改善步速、步长和对称性方面的短期益处。虽然仍需大型临床试验和实际可用性研究，但它提示了机器人辅助技术在神经康复中的潜力。
items.titleZh: 髋部机器人外骨骼在步态康复中的应用：从设计到临床证据的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 这项对 19 项关于髋部机器人外骨骼在步态康复中应用的人体研究的系统综述发现，其在步速、步长和对称性方面均有改善。尽管长期临床影响有限，但双边辅助和自适应控制策略在显示积极结果的研究中被频繁使用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review synthesizes evidence on robotic hip exoskeletons for gait rehabilitation, pointing to short-term benefits in walking speed, step length, and symmetry. While large clinical trials and real-world usability studies are still needed, it suggests the potential of robotic assistance in neurorehabilitation.
items.limitation: 现有证据多集中于短期功能益处，长期临床影响尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: Existing evidence primarily focuses on short-term functional benefits, with limited data on sustained clinical impact.

items.title: Does whole-body electromyostimulation improve functional, compositional, and biochemical outcomes in older women with sarcopenia? A randomized controlled trial
items.summary: This open-label RCT of 30 sarcopenic older women found 8 weeks of whole-body electromyostimulation (WB-EMS) significantly improved balance, handgrip strength, functional capacity, body composition (reduced body weight/BMI/fat, increased skeletal muscle mass), and myokine levels (decreased myostatin, increased follistatin) compared to controls. The trial was retrospectively registered.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提示，全身电肌肉刺激（WB-EMS）在肌少症老年女性中能改善身体功能、身体成分和肌因子水平。对于无法进行常规阻力训练的患者，WB-EMS 可能是一个时间高效的替代方案，但需等待更大规模、更高质量的研究验证。
items.titleZh: 全身电肌肉刺激能否改善肌少症老年女性的功能、身体成分和生化结局？一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项对 30 名肌少症老年女性进行的开放标签随机对照试验发现，与对照组相比，8 周的全身电肌肉刺激 (WB-EMS) 显著改善了平衡、握力、功能能力、身体成分（体重/BMI/脂肪减少，骨骼肌质量增加）和肌因子水平（肌抑素减少，卵泡抑素增加）。本试验为回顾性注册。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that whole-body electromyostimulation (WB-EMS) can improve physical function, body composition, and myokine levels in sarcopenic older women. For patients unable to perform conventional resistance training, WB-EMS might be a time-efficient alternative, but validation from larger, higher-quality studies is needed.
items.limitation: 本研究为开放标签试验，未进行分配隐藏和结局评估盲法，可能存在偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was an open-label trial without allocation concealment and blinded outcome assessment, which may introduce bias.

items.title: Strength Training in Youth: A Scoping Review with Evidence Gap Map
items.summary: This scoping review of 342 studies on youth strength training (6–18 years) found 90% assessed physical performance, with limited focus on motor competence, injury prevention, or psychosocial factors. Key gaps include under-representation of female participants, scarce studies on biologically mature adolescents, and lack of long-term follow-up beyond 6 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述发现，青少年力量训练的研究主要集中在身体表现上，但在女性参与者、生物成熟度评估、长期随访和心理社会结局方面存在显著差距。这提醒临床医师在为青少年制定训练方案时，需关注这些研究盲区。
items.titleZh: 青少年力量训练：一项带证据差距地图的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 这项对 342 项青少年力量训练（6-18 岁）研究的范围综述发现，90% 的研究评估了身体表现，而对运动能力、损伤预防或社会心理因素的关注有限。主要空白包括女性参与者不足、对生物成熟青少年研究稀缺以及缺乏超过 6 个月的长期随访。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review found that youth strength training research predominantly focuses on physical performance, with significant gaps in female representation, biological maturation assessment, long-term follow-up, and psychosocial outcomes. This highlights critical blind spots for clinicians when designing training programs for young athletes.
items.limitation: 本综述识别的是证据空白，而非提供训练实践的确定性建议。
items.limitationEn: This review identifies evidence gaps rather than providing definitive recommendations for training practice.

items.title: Education and training pathways for advanced musculoskeletal physiotherapists: a qualitative study investigating competency.
items.summary: A qualitative study in Tasmania, Australia, with 12 advanced musculoskeletal physiotherapists identified themes around education and training, highlighting that while workplace training supports clinical expertise, it lacks health-service collaboration and opportunities for external integration, suggesting a need for system-wide alignment.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了澳大利亚高级肌肉骨骼物理治疗师教育和培训体系中的系统性脱节。它提醒你，现有体系在支持高级执业能力方面仍有不足，尤其在跨机构协作和政策与监管的协调上。
items.titleZh: 高级肌肉骨骼物理治疗师的教育和培训路径：一项关于能力培养的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚州一项针对 12 名高级肌肉骨骼物理治疗师的定性研究发现，当前工作场所培训支持临床专长，但缺乏卫生服务协作和外部整合机会，提示需进行系统性调整以更好地支持高级执业需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals systemic disconnects in Australia's advanced musculoskeletal physiotherapist education and training. It reminds you that the current system still falls short in supporting advanced practice competencies, particularly regarding inter-organizational collaboration and policy-regulatory alignment.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小且仅限于澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚州，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study with a small sample size, limited to Tasmania, Australia, has limited generalizability.

items.title: Current Clinical Practice and Barriers to Instrumented Gait Assessment in Stroke Rehabilitation: A Cross-Sectional Survey.
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey of 329 Japanese physiotherapists found that 91.2% recognized the need for instrumented gait assessment in stroke rehabilitation, but only 39.8% used it routinely due to equipment unavailability (80.2% of non-users), excessive measurement time (≥20 min associated with perceived burden), high costs, and interpretation difficulties.
items.curatedReason: 尽管器械步态评估在卒中康复中被广泛认为必要，但普及率依然有限。本研究提醒你其主要障碍在于设备可及性、测量耗时和结果解读难度，这为你在考虑引入相关技术时提供了明确的考量方向。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复中器械步态评估的当前临床实践和障碍：一项横断面调查
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 329 名日本物理治疗师的横断面调查发现，91.2% 的受访者认为卒中康复中器械步态评估是必要的，但仅 39.8% 日常使用，主要障碍是设备不可用（非使用者中占 80.2%）、测量时间过长（≥20 分钟与感知负担相关）、设备成本高以及结果解读困难。
items.curatedReasonEn: Despite wide recognition of instrumented gait assessment's necessity in stroke rehabilitation, its routine use remains limited. This study highlights key barriers—equipment access, measurement time, and interpretation difficulty—providing clear considerations if you are contemplating integrating such technologies.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查，存在回忆偏倚和样本选择偏倚，且仅限于日本的物理治疗师，结果的外推性有局限。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional survey may be subject to recall and selection bias, and its findings, based solely on Japanese physiotherapists, have limited generalizability.

items.title: Interval Between Injury and Surgery Influences Knee Biomechanics During Walking in Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstructed Patients: A Systematic Review with Meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review of 16 studies (n=3522) found ACLR patients had lower peak knee flexion angle (SMD = -0.33), peak knee adduction angle (SMD = -0.47), and peak knee flexion moment (SMD = -0.64) during walking compared to controls. Delayed reconstruction (≥12 months) was associated with persistent sagittal plane deficits, while early surgery (within 6 months) had fewer long-term sagittal-plane deficits but some temporary frontal-plane asymmetries and extension deficits.
items.curatedReason: ACLR 患者的步态生物力学问题，比如膝关节屈曲、内收角度和屈曲力矩减小，是普遍现象。如果你考虑进行 ACLR，请注意：这项系统综述明确指出，手术时机至关重要，延迟手术（≥12 个月）会带来持续的矢状面缺陷，而早期手术（<6 个月）能有效减少这些长期问题。尽管早期手术可能伴随短暂的额状面不对称和伸展缺陷，但权衡之下，早期干预对改善长期步态生物力学更有利。
items.titleZh: 损伤与手术间隔影响 ACL 重建患者步行时膝关节生物力学：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 16 项研究（n=3522）的系统综述发现，ACLR 患者步行时峰值膝关节屈曲角（SMD = -0.33）、峰值膝关节内收角（SMD = -0.47）和峰值膝关节屈曲力矩（SMD = -0.64）均低于健康对照。延迟重建（≥12 个月）与持续的矢状面缺陷相关，而早期手术（6 个月内）与较少的长期矢状面缺陷相关，但可能存在早期暂时性额状面不对称和伸展缺陷。
items.curatedReasonEn: ACLR patients commonly exhibit gait biomechanical issues, such as reduced peak knee flexion and adduction angles, and flexion moment. If you're considering ACLR, note that this systematic review unequivocally shows surgical timing is crucial: delayed surgery (≥12 months) leads to persistent sagittal plane deficits, while early surgery (<6 months) significantly reduces these long-term issues. While early surgery might bring temporary frontal plane asymmetries and extension deficits, early intervention is more beneficial for improving long-term gait biomechanics when weighing the options.
items.limitation: 研究间存在高度异质性（I²高达88%），可能影响结果的综合解释和推论。
items.limitationEn: High heterogeneity among studies (I² up to 88%) may affect the interpretation and generalizability of the pooled results.

items.title: Gait variability as a predictor of fall risk in patients with stroke: A 6-month prospective cohort study with survival analysis.
items.summary: A 6-month prospective cohort study (n=112) of stroke patients found stride time variability (STV) at discharge to be the only independent predictor of post-discharge falls. An optimal STV cutoff of 3.40% yielded an AUC of 0.756 (95% CI 0.657-0.851), with 88.2% sensitivity and 53.8% specificity for fall prediction.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性队列研究表明，出院时步态时间变异性（STV）是卒中患者出院后 6 个月内跌倒的独立预测因子。当 STV 超过 3.40% 时，你应加强跌倒预防干预，这可以作为传统评估的补充指标。
items.titleZh: 步态变异性作为卒中患者跌倒风险的预测因子：一项 6 个月前瞻性队列研究及生存分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 112 名卒中患者的 6 个月前瞻性队列研究发现，出院时的步态时间变异性（STV）是出院后跌倒的唯一独立预测因子。STV 的最佳临界值为 3.40%，其曲线下面积（AUC）为 0.756（95% CI 0.657-0.851），预测跌倒的敏感性为 88.2%，特异性为 53.8%。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study indicates that stride time variability (STV) at discharge is an independent predictor of falls within 6 months post-discharge in stroke patients. You should intensify fall prevention interventions when STV exceeds 3.40%, using this as a complementary indicator to conventional assessments.
items.limitation: 该研究为单中心队列研究，且样本量相对较小（n=112），结果推广性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center cohort study with a relatively small sample size (n=112), which may limit the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: The new body-as-machine: a response to Breedt, Tichenor, and Barlott's "Diagnosing the body in physiotherapy".
items.summary: This response paper critically reflects on a recent article, "Diagnosing the body in physiotherapy," acknowledging its strengths while highlighting tensions regarding Foucauldian biopower, the narrow focus on musculoskeletal practice, and the link between process philosophy and neoliberalism.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评批评了物理治疗行业将身体视为机器的倾向，并挑战了行业对生物心理社会模式的声明。它促使你反思在临床实践中对身体概念的深层哲学假设。
items.titleZh: 新的身体即机器观：对 Breedt, Tichenor, and Barlott "物理治疗中身体的诊断"一文的回应
items.summaryZh: 这篇回应文章对 Breedt, Tichenor, and Barlott 的 "物理治疗中身体的诊断" 一文进行了批判性反思，肯定了其优点，但也指出了在福柯生物权力、对肌肉骨骼实践的狭隘关注以及过程哲学与新自由主义之间联系方面的张力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary criticizes the physiotherapy profession's tendency to view the body as a machine and challenges its claims to a biopsychosocial model. It prompts you to reflect on the deep philosophical assumptions underpinning your concept of the body in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 这是一篇批判性述评，并非基于实证研究，观点可能存在主观性。
items.limitationEn: This is a critical commentary, not based on empirical research, and its perspectives may be subjective.

items.title: Physiotherapy and Exercise-Based Rehabilitation for Mental Health: A Two-Decade Bibliometric Analysis of Global Trends, Thematic Evolution, and the Socioeconomic Vulnerability Gap (2006-2025).
items.summary: A bibliometric analysis of 5223 publications (2006-2025) found a 22.6-fold increase in research on physical rehabilitation and mental health, predominantly from high-income countries (75.9%), with socioeconomic vulnerability remaining an under-researched theme (4.6% of publications explicitly referencing it).
items.curatedReason: 这项文献计量分析显示，物理治疗和运动康复在精神健康领域的文献量显著增长，但研究主要集中在高收入国家。这提示你在推动运动干预应用于精神健康时，应更多关注低资源环境、成本效益和实施科学，以解决社会经济脆弱性差距。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗和运动康复在精神健康中的作用：全球趋势、主题演变和社会经济脆弱性差距的二十年文献计量分析（2006-2025）
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 5223 篇文献（2006-2025）的文献计量分析显示，物理康复与精神健康交叉领域的研究增长了 22.6 倍，但主要集中在高收入国家（75.9%），社会经济脆弱性仍是研究不足的主题（4.6% 的文献明确提及）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This bibliometric analysis reveals substantial growth in physical rehabilitation literature for mental health, yet research is concentrated in high-income countries. This suggests that when advocating for exercise interventions in mental health, you should prioritize low-resource settings, cost-effectiveness, and implementation science to address socioeconomic vulnerability gaps.
items.limitation: 本研究作为文献计量分析，无法提供具体临床干预的效果证据，且对“社会经济脆弱性”的关键词识别存在误报率（37.5% 精度）。
items.limitationEn: As a bibliometric analysis, this study cannot provide evidence on the effectiveness of specific clinical interventions, and the keyword identification for "socioeconomic vulnerability" had a false-positive rate (37.5% precision).
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Experiences of physiotherapists in managing pelvic floor disorders at public hospitals in uThukela district, South Africa.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 12 physiotherapists in South Africa identified limited undergraduate training, inadequate resources, understaffing, and poor referral pathways as key barriers to managing pelvic floor disorders in public hospitals.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了南非公立医院物理治疗师在管理盆底障碍时面临的资源不足、转诊路径不畅和培训不足等挑战。这对你了解医疗资源受限地区盆底康复服务的困境和改进方向有价值。
items.titleZh: 南非 uThukela 地区公立医院物理治疗师管理盆底功能障碍的经验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对南非 12 名物理治疗师的定性研究发现，本科培训不足、资源匮乏、人员短缺和转诊路径不畅是公立医院管理盆底功能障碍的主要障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights challenges faced by physiotherapists managing pelvic floor disorders in South African public hospitals, including inadequate resources, poor referral pathways, and insufficient training. This is valuable for understanding the systemic barriers to pelvic health physiotherapy in under-resourced settings and identifying areas for improvement.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性设计，样本量小（12 名物理治疗师），结果主要反映南非 uThukela 地区的特定经验，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study with a small sample (12 physiotherapists) reflects specific experiences in South Africa's uThukela district, limiting generalizability.
items.journal: The South African journal of physiotherapy

items.title: Health-seeking behaviours of people with osteoarthritis in sub-Saharan Africa: A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of five studies in sub-Saharan Africa found delayed and fragmented health-seeking behaviors for osteoarthritis, influenced by beliefs (OA as normal aging), poor knowledge, limited person-centered care, and access barriers like high costs and long waiting times.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述发现撒哈拉以南非洲骨关节炎患者的健康寻求行为普遍延迟和碎片化。这提示你在该地区推广物理治疗时，需要加强患者教育、自我管理支持，并拓展社区康复服务。
items.titleZh: 撒哈拉以南非洲骨关节炎患者健康寻求行为的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项针对撒哈拉以南非洲的五项研究的范围综述发现，骨关节炎患者的健康寻求行为普遍延迟和碎片化，受限于对骨关节炎的认知、服务可及性差、费用高昂和等待时间长。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review indicates that health-seeking behaviors for osteoarthritis in sub-Saharan Africa are largely delayed and fragmented. This suggests that when promoting physiotherapy in this region, you should prioritize patient education, self-management support, and expanded community-based rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本综述仅纳入五项研究，且集中于尼日利亚和南非的农村地区，证据基础薄弱，可能无法全面反映整个撒哈拉以南非洲的情况。
items.limitationEn: This review included only five studies, predominantly from rural Nigeria and South Africa, providing a limited evidence base and potentially not reflecting the broader sub-Saharan African context.
items.journal: The South African journal of physiotherapy

items.title: A COSMIN systematic review of performance-based assessment tools for mealtime performance in Parkinson's disease: a linking study based on the ICF framework.
items.summary: A COSMIN systematic review identified only two performance-based assessment tools for mealtime performance in Parkinson's disease, the Mealtime Assessment Scale (MAS) and the modified OARS scale, noting limited ICF coverage and lack of content validity testing for both.
items.curatedReason: 这份 COSMIN 系统综述揭示，帕金森病患者的用餐表现评估工具稀缺，现有工具 ICF 覆盖不全且缺乏充分的内容效度验证。在评估帕金森病患者的用餐功能时，你不能仅关注吞咽，需考虑姿势、餐具使用和认知因素。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病患者用餐表现基于性能评估工具的 COSMIN 系统综述：基于 ICF 框架的关联研究
items.summaryZh: 一项 COSMIN 系统综述发现，帕金森病患者用餐表现的基于性能评估工具仅有餐时评估量表 (MAS) 和改良老年美国人资源与服务量表 (OARS) 两种，它们 ICF 覆盖范围有限，且缺乏内容效度验证。
items.curatedReasonEn: This COSMIN systematic review reveals a scarcity of performance-based mealtime assessment tools for Parkinson's disease, with existing tools having incomplete ICF coverage and lacking robust content validity. When assessing mealtime function in PD patients, you should look beyond swallowing to include posture, utensil handling, and cognitive factors.
items.limitation: 本综述仅纳入两项研究，且两种评估工具均缺乏独立的内容效度测试，使得该领域缺乏强有力的评估证据。
items.limitationEn: This review included only two studies, and both assessment tools lacked independent content validity testing, indicating a weak evidence base for assessment in this area.

items.title: Client Challenge
items.summary: A three-arm RCT (n=48) found that both suspension core training and pressure biofeedback-guided core training significantly reduced pain and disability in chronic mechanical low back pain patients after four weeks compared to an advice-only control. Suspension core training showed additional benefits over pressure biofeedback in lumbar extension ROM and core muscle endurance, but not in pain intensity or flexion ROM.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性机械性腰痛，与单独建议相比，悬吊核心训练和压力生物反馈核心训练都能在短期内减轻疼痛和改善功能。悬吊核心训练在腰椎伸展 ROM 和核心耐力方面可能优于压力生物反馈，但并非所有结果都一致。
items.titleZh: 悬吊核心训练与压力生物反馈训练对慢性机械性腰痛的疗效：一项三臂随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项三臂随机对照试验（n=48）显示，与单独建议相比，悬吊核心训练和压力生物反馈核心训练在慢性机械性腰痛患者中均能在四周后显著减轻疼痛和改善功能残疾。悬吊核心训练在腰椎伸展活动度（ROM）和核心肌耐力方面优于压力生物反馈，但在疼痛强度或屈曲 ROM 上无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic mechanical low back pain, both suspension core training and pressure biofeedback core training significantly reduce pain and improve function short-term compared to advice alone. Suspension core training may offer additional benefits in lumbar extension ROM and core endurance over pressure biofeedback, though not consistently across all outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小、干预期短且无随访数据，结果需谨慎解读。
items.limitationEn: The study's small sample size, short intervention period, and lack of follow-up warrant cautious interpretation.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: APTA State Chapters Advance Payment, Access, and Practice in 2026
items.summary: APTA announced that its state chapters achieved significant legislative victories in 2026, enhancing payment protections, expanding scope of practice, and improving patient access to physical therapy care across the United States. These successes underscore the impact of member advocacy on the profession.
items.curatedReason: APTA 报告其各州分会于 2026 年在支付、准入和执业范围方面取得了立法胜利，这直接影响您作为 PT/PTA 的报销、执业自主权和患者服务能力。持续关注这些地方性政策变动，确保您的执业符合最新规定。
items.titleZh: APTA 各州分会在2026年推动支付、准入和执业进步
items.summaryZh: APTA 宣布，其各州分会在2026年取得了重要的立法胜利，加强了支付保障，扩大了执业范围，并改善了美国各地患者获得物理治疗服务的机会。这些成功凸显了会员倡导对专业发展的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA reports its state chapters secured legislative victories in payment, access, and scope of practice in 2026, directly impacting your reimbursement, practice autonomy, and patient service capabilities as a PT/PTA. Continuously monitor these localized policy changes to ensure your practice aligns with the latest regulations.

items.title: Reported Approaches to Vaginal Pessary Use for Treating Pelvic Organ Prolapse in Women: A Secondary Analysis of Randomised Controlled Trials
items.summary: A secondary analysis of 14 RCTs on vaginal pessary use for pelvic organ prolapse (POP) found large variation in how intervention components were reported using the TIDieR checklist. Only one study provided details for all 12 TIDieR domains, indicating a lack of detail for reproducibility and transferability to clinical practice.
items.curatedReason: 该分析揭示了在盆腔器官脱垂（POP）的随机对照试验（RCT）中，阴道子宫托干预的报告细节存在显著差异，这提示您在评估和采用这些研究结果时，需要更关注其可复现性和临床实践可转化性。
items.titleZh: 女性盆腔器官脱垂阴道子宫托使用方法的报告方式：一项随机对照试验的次级分析
items.summaryZh: 对14项关于女性盆腔器官脱垂（POP）阴道子宫托使用的随机对照试验（RCT）进行二次分析发现，干预措施各组成部分的报告方式存在巨大差异。仅一项研究提供了所有12个TIDieR领域的所有细节，表明当前报告缺乏可复现性和临床实践可转化性所需的细节。
items.curatedReasonEn: This analysis reveals significant variability in reporting details for vaginal pessary interventions in RCTs for pelvic organ prolapse (POP), suggesting you should exercise greater scrutiny regarding reproducibility and clinical translatability when evaluating and adopting these research findings.
items.limitation: 本研究为次级分析，仅关注RCT中报告的干预方法，未评估其疗效或设计质量。
items.limitationEn: This secondary analysis focused solely on reported intervention approaches in RCTs and did not evaluate their efficacy or design quality.

items.title: Sensor-based motion analysis identifies distinct biomechanical recovery trajectories following internal fixation and arthroplasty: a retrospective longitudinal cohort study
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (n=228) using sensor-based motion analysis identified a limited subset of 12 measures with FDR-supported differences in biomechanical recovery trajectories over 200 postoperative days between hip internal fixation and arthroplasty patients. These included balance, gait, chair-stand, kinematic, and patient-reported variables.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究提示，髋关节内固定与关节置换术后早期恢复的生物力学轨迹存在差异。在临床实践中，您可以根据患者的术式和诊断，考虑使用传感器数据来监测其个性化康复进程。
items.titleZh: 髋关节内固定与关节置换术后生物力学恢复轨迹的传感器分析：一项回顾性纵向队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（n=228）使用传感器运动分析，在髋关节内固定和关节置换术后200天内，识别出12项指标在生物力学恢复轨迹上存在显著差异，包括平衡、步态、起立坐下、运动学和患者自评变量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study suggests distinct biomechanical recovery trajectories post-hip internal fixation versus arthroplasty. In clinical practice, you might consider using sensor-based data to monitor individualized rehabilitation progress, tailored to the patient's surgical procedure and diagnosis.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性探索性队列研究，且未获取康复暴露数据，其发现具有关联性而非因果性，需在诊断特异性队列中进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective exploratory cohort study lacked rehabilitation exposure data, making its findings associative rather than causal; external validation in diagnosis-specific cohorts is required.

items.title:
Satisfaction with hospital-based outpatient rehabilitation in people with Parkinson's disease and its association with life satisfaction and health-related quality of life: a longitudinal national register study
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A longitudinal national register study (n=173) of Parkinson's disease patients found that over 82% were satisfied with hospital-based outpatient rehabilitation. High satisfaction was associated with higher life satisfaction and health-related quality of life at discharge, with broader associations observed in men and older adults (>69 years).
items.curatedReason: 帕金森病患者对院外康复的满意度与出院时的生活满意度和健康相关生命质量正相关。在评估和优化康复方案时，您应关注患者的康复体验和患者报告结局，尤其对男性和老年患者，这种关联更为显著。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病患者对医院门诊康复的满意度及其与生活满意度和健康相关生命质量的关联：一项纵向国家登记研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对173名帕金森病患者的纵向国家登记研究发现，超过82%的患者对医院门诊康复感到满意。高满意度与出院时的更高生活满意度和健康相关生命质量相关，其中男性和老年患者（>69岁）的关联更广泛。
items.curatedReasonEn: Patient satisfaction with outpatient rehabilitation for Parkinson's disease is positively associated with life satisfaction and health-related quality of life at discharge. When evaluating and optimizing rehabilitation programs, you should consider patients' experiences and patient-reported outcomes, especially as this association is more pronounced in men and older adults.
items.limitation: 本研究为国家登记研究，依赖自我报告问卷数据，可能存在报告偏差，且未能建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This national register study relied on self-reported questionnaire data, which may introduce reporting bias, and could not establish causality.

items.title: Force and Power Testing in Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction Literature: A Scoping Review
items.summary: A scoping review of 1625 studies on force and power testing post-ACLR identified significant heterogeneity in device selection, metrics, and protocols. Isokinetic dynamometry (64.9%) remained the most adopted testing device, but assessment practices have become more varied, with studies using 1.42 ± 0.62 devices on average.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述揭示了前交叉韧带重建术后力量和爆发力测试方法的显著异质性。在临床实践中，这意味着您在解读不同研究结果时需注意其评估工具和方案的差异，并考虑结合多种设备进行更全面的评估。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建文献中力量和爆发力测试：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对1625项关于前交叉韧带重建术后力量和爆发力测试的研究进行的范围综述发现，设备选择、测量指标和方案存在显著异质性。等速测力计（64.9%）仍是最常用的测试设备，但评估实践已变得更加多样化，平均每项研究使用1.42 ± 0.62种设备。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review reveals significant heterogeneity in force and power testing methods post-ACL reconstruction. In clinical practice, this means you need to account for differences in assessment tools and protocols when interpreting various study results, and consider combining multiple devices for a more comprehensive evaluation.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，侧重于现有文献的总结和描述，未进行质量评估和综合分析。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review focused on synthesizing and describing existing literature, without conducting quality assessment or comprehensive analysis.

items.title: Exploring association patterns among muscle mass, gait speed, and upper- and lower-limb muscle strength in sarcopenic and non-sarcopenic swiss community-dwelling older adults: a cross-sectional secondary analysis using portable, field-ready assessments
items.summary: A cross-sectional secondary analysis (N=198) in Swiss community-dwelling older adults found that LLSmax correlated more strongly with ALM/height² in sarcopenic (ρ=0.79) than non-sarcopenic (ρ=0.56) participants, while ULSmax showed the opposite pattern. Gait speed was not significantly associated with any measure in the sarcopenic group.
items.curatedReason: 这项次级分析提示，在肌少症患者中，附肢瘦体重（ALM/height²）与下肢最大力量（LLSmax）的关联可能更强，而非肌少症患者则与上肢最大力量（ULSmax）关联更强。虽然样本量限制了结论，但这鼓励您在肌少症筛查中，继续探索将便携式下肢力量评估工具作为手握力测试的补充。
items.titleZh: 瑞士社区居住老年人肌少症和非肌少症患者肌量、步速以及上肢和下肢肌力关联模式的探索：一项使用便携式现场评估的横断面次级分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对瑞士社区居住老年人（N=198）的横断面次级分析发现，肌少症患者的下肢最大力量（LLSmax）与附肢瘦体重（ALM/height²）的相关性更强（ρ=0.79），而非肌少症患者则显示出相反模式。在肌少症组中，步速与任何测量指标均无显著关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This secondary analysis suggests that appendicular lean mass (ALM/height²) may correlate more strongly with lower-limb maximal strength (LLSmax) in sarcopenic individuals, while correlating more strongly with upper-limb maximal strength (ULSmax) in non-sarcopenic individuals. Though limited by sample size, this encourages you to continue exploring portable lower-limb strength assessments as a complement to handgrip testing in sarcopenia screening.
items.limitation: 本研究肌少症亚组样本量较小（N=17），未能发现组间相关系数的显著差异，结果需谨慎解读。
items.limitationEn: The sarcopenic subgroup in this study was small (N=17), and no significant between-group differences in correlation coefficients were found, requiring cautious interpretation of results.
items.journal: European Review of Aging and Physical Activity

items.title: Unpacking what works in home rehabilitation in relation to contexts, mechanisms, and outcomes in a qualitative scoping review
items.summary: A qualitative scoping review of 62 studies identified three categories (professional knowledge and approach, home and everyday life, focus on personalization) of contextual factors and mechanisms influencing outcomes in home rehabilitation for older adults. These factors shape resources and reasoning contributing to rehabilitation outcomes from the perspectives of older adults, relatives, and staff.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性范围综述识别了影响老年人居家康复效果的关键情境因素和机制。在设计居家康复服务时，您应关注个性化、专业知识、沟通以及家庭与日常生活的整合，以实现以人为本的服务。
items.titleZh: 定性范围综述：剖析居家康复中情境、机制和结果的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项对62项研究进行的定性范围综述识别出影响老年人居家康复结果的情境因素和机制的三个类别（专业知识与方法、居家与日常生活、关注个性化）。这些因素从老年人、家属和医护人员的角度，塑造了有助于康复结果的资源和推理。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative scoping review identifies key contextual factors and mechanisms influencing home rehabilitation outcomes for older adults. When designing home rehabilitation services, you should focus on personalization, professional expertise, communication, and the integration of home and daily life to achieve person-centered care.
items.limitation: 本范围综述仅纳入定性研究，未能提供居家康复干预的量化效果或证据等级。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review included only qualitative studies, providing no quantitative effects or evidence levels for home rehabilitation interventions.

items.title: Chart-derived frailty index is associated with long-term mortality and longitudinal health-related quality of life after hip fracture surgery in older adults: a secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
items.summary: A secondary analysis of a prospective cohort (n=1072) found that a higher chart-derived frailty index (CFI) was associated with increased mortality (adjusted HR 2.621) and poorer health-related quality of life after hip fracture surgery in older adults. Exploratory analyses also suggested poorer long-term walking ability and mobility in the high-CFI group.
items.curatedReason: 图表衍生衰弱指数（CFI）与髋部骨折老年患者的长期死亡率和健康相关生命质量相关。在术后康复管理中，您可以利用CFI作为评估工具，识别高风险患者，并可能调整康复计划以改善预后。
items.titleZh: 图表衍生衰弱指数与髋部骨折老年患者长期死亡率和纵向健康相关生命质量的关联：一项前瞻性队列研究的次级分析
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性队列研究（n=1072）的次级分析发现，髋部骨折老年患者的图表衍生衰弱指数（CFI）较高者，与更高的死亡率（调整后HR 2.621）和较差的健康相关生命质量相关。探索性分析还提示高CFI组的长期步行能力和活动能力较差。
items.curatedReasonEn: The chart-derived frailty index (CFI) is associated with long-term mortality and health-related quality of life in older adults with hip fractures. In postoperative rehabilitation management, you can use CFI as an assessment tool to identify high-risk patients and potentially adjust rehabilitation plans to improve outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究为前瞻性队列的次级分析，对纵向轨迹差异的证据受模型设定影响，且功能结局分析为探索性。
items.limitationEn: This secondary analysis of a prospective cohort found evidence for different longitudinal trajectories sensitive to model specification, and functional outcome analyses were exploratory.

items.title: Psychological readiness, active knee flexion and patient-reported knee function at 12 and 18 months after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: a retrospective cohort study
items.summary: A single-center retrospective cohort study (n=75) on ACLR patients found that higher psychological readiness (ACL-RSI) was associated with higher concurrent patient-reported knee function (Lysholm score) at 12 and 18 months post-surgery. Active knee flexion increased by 4.00° (95% CI, 3.15°–4.85°; P < 0.001) but was not significantly associated with Lysholm score.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，在前交叉韧带重建术后，患者的心理准备状态与患者自评膝关节功能存在正相关。在术后评估中，您除了关注身体功能指标外，还应将心理准备状态纳入考量。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建术后12和18个月的心理准备状态、膝关节主动屈曲和患者自评膝关节功能：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对75名前交叉韧带重建（ACLR）患者的单中心回顾性队列研究发现，术后12和18个月，较高的心理准备状态（ACL-RSI）与较高的患者自评膝关节功能（Lysholm评分）相关。主动膝关节屈曲增加了4.00°（95% CI，3.15°–4.85%；P < 0.001），但与Lysholm评分无显著关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates a positive association between psychological readiness and patient-reported knee function after ACL reconstruction. In postoperative assessment, you should consider psychological readiness alongside physical function measures.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心回顾性队列研究，样本量小，未建立因果关系，且对随访期间关联差异的评估不精确。
items.limitationEn: This single-center retrospective cohort study had a small sample size, did not establish causality, and its assessment of association differences over follow-up was imprecise.

items.title: [Correspondence] The F-words for Child Development: Lessons Learned
items.summary: The creators of the "F-words for Child Development" framework thank Wilson et al. for their advocacy, fully endorsing the expanded set of ideas regarding disability, which includes function, family, fitness, fun, and future.
items.curatedReason: 这篇通信是对“儿童发育 F 词框架”的再次肯定，它强调了功能、家庭、健身、乐趣和未来等因素在儿童残疾康复中的核心作用。这为你理解以家庭为中心、以功能为导向的儿童康复理念提供了进一步支持。
items.titleZh: 儿童发育 F 词：经验教训
items.summaryZh: “儿童发育 F 词”框架的创建者们感谢 Wilson 及其同事对该理念的推广，并完全认可这一扩展的残疾概念集合，其中包括功能、家庭、健身、乐趣和未来。
items.curatedReasonEn: This correspondence reaffirms the "F-words for Child Development" framework, emphasizing the central role of function, family, fitness, fun, and future in pediatric disability rehabilitation. It provides further support for your understanding of family-centered, function-oriented pediatric rehabilitation concepts.

items.title: The clinical reasoning associated with prognosis and musculoskeletal disorders - A Masterclass in incorporating prognostic reasoning into physiotherapy practice.
items.summary: This masterclass article outlines a practical framework for physiotherapists to incorporate clinical reasoning associated with prognosis into their management of musculoskeletal disorders, aiming to optimize patient outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 本篇「大师班」文章深入探讨了预后判断在骨科物理治疗中的核心地位，提供了一个实用的框架，指导你如何将预后思维融入临床实践，优化患者结局。
items.titleZh: 与预后和肌肉骨骼疾病相关的临床推理——将预后推理纳入物理治疗实践的大师班课程
items.summaryZh: 这篇大师班文章为物理治疗师提供了一个实用框架，旨在将预后相关的临床推理融入肌肉骨骼疾病管理中，以优化患者结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This "Masterclass" article delves into the core role of prognostic reasoning in orthopedic physical therapy, providing a practical framework to guide you in integrating prognosis into your clinical practice to optimize patient outcomes.
items.limitation: 本篇为专家意见，而非基于原创研究数据。
items.limitationEn: This is an expert opinion article, not based on original research data.

items.title: Physiatry-physiotherapy interdisciplinary project (PHY 2 ): Service evaluation of a new caregiving model for musculoskeletal pain by advanced practice physiotherapists in the physiatry department.
items.summary: A single-center prospective descriptive cohort study (n=300) found that Advanced Practice Physiotherapists (APPs) independently managed 41% of musculoskeletal pain patients without physiatry consultation, reducing wait times and improving patient satisfaction.
items.curatedReason: 对于常见肌肉骨骼疼痛，高级执业物理治疗师（APP）可以独立承担近一半的患者管理工作（41%），并且可以有效缩短等待时间、提高患者满意度。在你的机构中，可以考虑更大力度地授权APP来管理这类患者，提升效率。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗-理疗科多学科项目 (PHY2)：高级执业物理治疗师在理疗科为肌肉骨骼疼痛患者提供新照护模式的服务评估
items.summaryZh: 一项单中心前瞻性描述性队列研究（n=300）发现，高级执业物理治疗师（APPs）独立管理了41%的肌肉骨骼疼痛患者，无需理疗师会诊，同时缩短了等待时间并提高了患者满意度。
items.curatedReasonEn: Advanced Practice Physiotherapists (APPs) can independently manage almost half (41%) of common musculoskeletal pain patients, effectively reducing wait times and improving patient satisfaction. Consider empowering APPs more robustly in your clinic to manage these patients, which could significantly boost efficiency.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心前瞻性描述性队列研究，且缺乏对照组，结果推广性受限。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center prospective descriptive cohort study without a control group, limiting the generalizability of its findings.
